Project Name:

Digital Regulatory Assurance System

Scope:

Modernization initiatives across the Government of Alberta are fundamentally changing how ministry users collect, manage, analyze, and use data as legacy systems are transformed into modern Data Management and Geospatial Platforms. This requires seamless data integration across multiple legacy and modern platforms to create a trusted, unified source of information.

DRAS is a Government of Alberta regulatory transformation initiative led by Environment and Protected Areas (EPA) to modernize, digitize, and streamline environmental and natural resource regulatory processes. DRAS supports the full regulatory lifecycle, from application and authorization to monitoring, compliance, remediation, and closure through a single, consolidated digital platform

As DRAS development continues, the volume, variety, and complexity of structured data continue to grow, creating a sustained need for dedicated data engineering and data integration expertise. The Talend Integration Analyst designs, builds, operates, and supports data integration solutions on the Government of Alberta's Talend Integration Platform, to move, transform, and consolidate data across ministry systems, cloud services, and analytics environments, and operational systems.

This is a hands-on technical role for someone who combines strong Talend and SQL development skills with a disciplined, service-oriented approach to platform operations including job scheduling, monitoring, error handling, and incident resolution; while collaborating with data engineers, platform administrators, ministry stakeholders, and vendor support partners.

This position will primarily support the Digital Regulatory Assurance System (DRAS) program, the role may be expanded to support additional enterprise data initiatives.

Duties:

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience developing data integration solutions with Talend (Data Integration / Data Fabric / Talend Studio)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL).
  • Proven experience designing ETL/ELT processes, data mappings, and transformation logic for enterprise data.
  • Experience operating and supporting integration jobs in a production environment, including scheduling, monitoring, and incident resolution.
  • Translate business and data requirements into robust technical designs, applying data-mapping, transformation, and reconciliation logic
  • Build parameterized, reusable, and context-aware jobs that promote cleanly across development, test, and production environments.
  • Implement performance-tuned, scalable integration patterns for both batch and near-real-time data movement.
  • Design and expose secure data services and APIs using Azure API Management for downstream systems.
  • Implement data governance practices, including metadata management, data classification, and lineage tracking.
  • Ensure compliance with privacy and regulatory standards (e.g., POPA) through role-based access controls, encryption, and data masking.
  • Design, develop, and unit-test Talend integration jobs, routes, and reusable components to extract, transform, and load data between source systems, databases, files, APIs, and cloud storage
  • Schedule, orchestrate, deploy, and monitor Talend jobs; proactively track execution, throughput, and failures.
  • Provide day-to-day operational support including triage, troubleshooting, and resolve integration incidents and data-load failures within agreed service levels.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and integrations, ensuring reliability, scalability, and performance across the platform.
  • Utilize AI and automation tools to streamline data engineering workflows, including pipeline development, testing, monitoring, and documentation.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools for code generation, optimization, and review to improve development efficiency and code quality.
  • Other duties as needed

raw.description:
Topl is a venture backed blockchain startup that helps small and large companies track, tokenize and monetize their sustainable impact claims. We have built a very unique value proposition in the Web3 space.
What are we looking for?
We look for a few things across all hires we make at Topl, regardless of role or team. First, we look for signals that a candidate will thrive in our fast-paced work environment, where we default to quick iterations, critical thinking, and sound judgments. Second, we seek people with the desire to share their expertise and the capacity to extend their knowledge to drive innovation. Finally, we seek candidates who can commit to a greater goal; unite as a team to reach something no one could have done on their own, and who want to leave a positive impact on the world.
About the Role:
As a Technical Product Manager and a Product Owner, you will be part of our Product Team to drive innovation around our code Blockchain products. You will help develop, document, and execute a comprehensive plan to understand user needs, iterate on product scope and ensure the timely development of highly complex technical products. With the CTO and CPO, you will be responsible for giving our teams the information and product methodology needed to succeed and continuously help us improve as an organization.

What we expect you to do:

  • Manage highly complex technical products at the fringe of innovation in the Blockchain space
  • Own and drive a rapidly scaling product roadmap
  • Work closely with the engineering team to convey product direction and deliver milestones
  • Manage Backlog and drive product development using agile methodology
  • Actively seek user feedback to focus on solving problems
  • Demonstrate a data-driven approach to product decisions along the product development lifecycle
  • Clearly and effectively communicate and document the product strategy, functionality, and requirements
  • Track, measure, analyze and communicate relevant KPIs as well as product development progress to key stakeholders
  • Collaborate with Designers to quickly iterate on UI implementations when necessary
  • Manage and support new Product Launches in collaboration with other departments: Marketing, Business Development, Engineering
  • Assist and support the CPO in the adoption of new processes
  • Work closely with the Ecosystem Team to ensure accurate technical documentation and support with problem resolution during Partner integrations

Requirements:

  • 5+ years in technical product management or technical product owner role, working closely with both businesses and developers in data-driven B2B/B2C initiatives and consumer-facing experience (preferably gaming, advertising, cloud, or data infrastructure)
  • Structured and organized written/verbal communication
  • Highly motivated self-starter able to work with minimal supervision
  • Ability to context-switch efficiently from - understanding the user’s need to getting into the technical detail
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and experience
  • Start-up experience in fast-paced environments working in agile, cross-functional teams
  • Experience using Web3 technologies.

Nice to have

  • Web3 Product experience
  • Software development experience

Competitive salary and equity plans
Medical, dental, and vision plans
Flexible vacation and office policy
Casual but focused work environment
Opportunities for professional development including conferences and hackathons
Equity
Culture that embraces diversity and open discussion

Ein “das haben wir immer so gemacht” wirst du bei uns nicht hören. Wir belohnen Kreativität, treiben Vereinfachung und suchen Innovation.

Als Werkstudent:in Salesspielst du eine entscheidende Rolle in diesem Prozess: Du unterstützt unser AI.SEE Sales Team bei der Erschließung neuer Marktpotenziale und beim Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Sales Manager:innen und dem Produktteam zusammen und lernst, wie komplexe KI-Lösungen im industriellen Umfeld positioniert und verkauft werden.

Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Industrie durch künstliche Intelligenz. 🚀

✅ Wir sind kein klassisches Unternehmen mit AI-Zusatz – wir verstehen uns als AI-Pioniere.

✅ Und wir glauben daran: KI stärkt den Menschen.

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Agentic Intelligence
raw.excerpt: What We’re BuildingHoneycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do!
raw.description:
What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!
If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Little more about the team:

AI agents at Honeycomb investigate, reason, and act on real observability data. They live in Canvas: the agentic workspace where engineers go to understand their systems.

The Agentic Intelligence team has shipped Canvas, the Honeycomb MCP server, and the Canvas Agent and Canvas Skills surfaces. What we're looking for today is someone who brings deep agent expertise and uses it to expand what the team can build: new agents, new surface area in Canvas, memory, spatial awareness, improved performance on our Bedrock loop.

Honeycomb's data store is fast and accepts high cardinality data; that's what makes agents built on top of it different from anything built on a conventional observability backend. This role is about taking advantage of that building agents that can do things no other observability product can do because the underlying data makes it possible.

Some of this work will start as a prototype. The expectation is that the code makes it through the full arc, from the rough first version through to something that holds up in production.

What you'll do

  • Design and deliver production-grade agents. Build agents that investigate, reason, and act on live observability data inside Canvas. These agents must be trustworthy to engineers in high pressure situations, including mid-incident. Take one from rough first version to something that holds up under production traffic.
  • Own the agent work; support the whole product. Scope, build, ship, and maintain the agents including the evals that tell you whether they got better or are just different. This role is agent-focused and also includes some fullstack development.
  • Build agents only Honeycomb can build. Use a data store that returns high-cardinality queries in seconds to reason over signal a conventional backend can't serve at this fidelity correlating across services, drilling into a single trace, comparing before and after a deploy.
  • Extend the surface, and decide what's next. Ship new capability into Canvas, the MCP server, and Canvas Skills memory, spatial awareness, a faster Bedrock loop and make the case for what comes after with working code. Distinguish hype from signal in a field with plenty of both.
  • Define what "good" means for agents here. Set the bar: measurable against real evals, maintainable, and honest about their limits.

Example projects

  • Multiple agents collaborating on one shared Canvas investigation each claiming a hypothesis, publishing findings, and narrowing the search space for the others so it resolves faster (blog).
  • Auto-investigation the moment an SLO burn alert fires the agent forms hypotheses and prepares visualizations before a human looks, cutting mean-time-to-insight for on-call (o11ycon 2026).
  • Skills that encode a team's domain expertise e.g. Kubernetes thresholds so agents and human colleagues can lean on them (o11ycon 2026).

What you'll bring:

  • AI and agent engineering experience. You've shipped LLM-based systems people relied on in production not demos, not fine-tuned models in a research context. You know where agent systems break and how to design around it.
  • End-to-end ownership. On a small team there's no handoff queue. You can take something from rough prototype to production-grade without needing someone behind you to do the durable engineering.
  • Current judgment, not just past experience. You have informed opinions about what's shifted in agent design in the last six to twelve months that would change how you'd build today.
  • Agent architecture depth. You understand how a fast, high-cardinality data store changes what an agent can reason about, and how to design for that.
  • Product judgment. You can look at what the agent layer does today and see what it should do next and make that case with a prototype, not a deck.

Even better

Observability or developer-tools background. Engineers are your users; you'll ramp faster with fluency in that world, and the work is better.

Familiarity with eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, and prompt engineering.

Base Salary based on level of experience
$250,000—$280,000 CAD

What you'll get when you join the Hive:

  • A stake in our success - generous equity with employee-friendly stock program
  • It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are - our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience
  • Time to recharge with unlimited PTO
  • A distributed-first mindset and culture (really!)
  • Home office, co-working, and internet stipend
  • Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents
  • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood
  • Annual development allowance
  • And much more...
Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time. Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work.

Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:

We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you:

Project Name:

Digital Regulatory Assurance System

Scope:

Modernization initiatives across the Government of Alberta are fundamentally changing how ministry users collect, manage, analyze, and use data as legacy systems are transformed into modern Data Management and Geospatial Platforms. This requires seamless data integration across multiple legacy and modern platforms to create a trusted, unified source of information.

DRAS is a Government of Alberta regulatory transformation initiative led by Environment and Protected Areas (EPA) to modernize, digitize, and streamline environmental and natural resource regulatory processes. DRAS supports the full regulatory lifecycle, from application and authorization to monitoring, compliance, remediation, and closure through a single, consolidated digital platform

As DRAS development continues, the volume, variety, and complexity of structured data continue to grow, creating a sustained need for dedicated data engineering and data integration expertise. The Talend Integration Analyst designs, builds, operates, and supports data integration solutions on the Government of Alberta's Talend Integration Platform, to move, transform, and consolidate data across ministry systems, cloud services, and analytics environments, and operational systems.

This is a hands-on technical role for someone who combines strong Talend and SQL development skills with a disciplined, service-oriented approach to platform operations including job scheduling, monitoring, error handling, and incident resolution; while collaborating with data engineers, platform administrators, ministry stakeholders, and vendor support partners.

This position will primarily support the Digital Regulatory Assurance System (DRAS) program, the role may be expanded to support additional enterprise data initiatives.

Duties:

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience developing data integration solutions with Talend (Data Integration / Data Fabric / Talend Studio)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL).
  • Proven experience designing ETL/ELT processes, data mappings, and transformation logic for enterprise data.
  • Experience operating and supporting integration jobs in a production environment, including scheduling, monitoring, and incident resolution.
  • Translate business and data requirements into robust technical designs, applying data-mapping, transformation, and reconciliation logic
  • Build parameterized, reusable, and context-aware jobs that promote cleanly across development, test, and production environments.
  • Implement performance-tuned, scalable integration patterns for both batch and near-real-time data movement.
  • Design and expose secure data services and APIs using Azure API Management for downstream systems.
  • Implement data governance practices, including metadata management, data classification, and lineage tracking.
  • Ensure compliance with privacy and regulatory standards (e.g., POPA) through role-based access controls, encryption, and data masking.
  • Design, develop, and unit-test Talend integration jobs, routes, and reusable components to extract, transform, and load data between source systems, databases, files, APIs, and cloud storage
  • Schedule, orchestrate, deploy, and monitor Talend jobs; proactively track execution, throughput, and failures.
  • Provide day-to-day operational support including triage, troubleshooting, and resolve integration incidents and data-load failures within agreed service levels.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and integrations, ensuring reliability, scalability, and performance across the platform.
  • Utilize AI and automation tools to streamline data engineering workflows, including pipeline development, testing, monitoring, and documentation.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools for code generation, optimization, and review to improve development efficiency and code quality.
  • Other duties as needed

raw.excerpt: About EthosEthos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale.
raw.description:
About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the roleEthos is hiring a Director, Marketing Process & Technology to join our Compliance department as a senior leader. This person will own marketing compliance review at Ethos end to end: the process, the technology, and the majority of the reviews themselves. You will be both a hands-on senior reviewer and the owner of the system that performs the review, and you will be charged with a clear mandate: move marketing review toward automation through AI as far as it can defensibly go, without loosening the standard.

You will serve as business owner of the AI tool Ethos uses for marketing review, and you will be measured, in part, on how much of the review volume that tool can absorb and how reliably it performs. At the same time, you will personally handle the judgment calls, escalations, and novel questions that automation should not decide. Beyond the tool, you own the marketing review process itself: intake, prioritization, review standards, approved language, recordkeeping, and the working relationship with Marketing/Brand/business teams. This is a player-coach role. You will carry a real review load from day one and will eventually hire and oversee a compliance analyst to support you, which means building the standards, playbooks, and training that make the work delegable. You will be expected to drive thought leadership on marketing compliance matters across Ethos. Importantly, the candidate must be risk-minded, be a team player, confident in determining acceptable risk, think creatively to always find solutions, and be technology forward.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Own the AI marketing review tool and drive the shift toward automated, AI review, including:

    • Act as business owner and administrator of the tool, including configuration, rule and prompt tuning, testing, and release management
    • Define the automation tiers : what AI approves outright, what AI reviews subject to human confirmation, and what always requires human review
    • Continuously improve automated review quality by measuring the tool’s output against human review, tuning to reduce missed issues, and expanding the categories of content it can handle
    • Establish human-in-the-loop thresholds, sampling, and ongoing QA to validate that the tool remains reliable as content, products, and regulations change
    • Own the auditability of AI-assisted decisions so that any approval can be reconstructed and defended to an examiner, auditor, or carrier
    • Partner with vendors and with internal engineering and data teams on integration, evaluation, and roadmap
    • Grow the share of reviews completed through automation as a primary, measured objective

Own the marketing compliance review process, including:

    • Design and run intake for all marketing review requests, with clear SLAs, routing, and prioritization
    • Maintain the review standards of record , including: review criteria, required disclosures, and the library of pre-approved claims and language
    • Personally perform the majority of reviews and serve as decision-maker on close calls, documenting rationale so decisions accumulate into usable precedent
    • Maintain the recordkeeping and audit trail of submissions, versions, approvals, and conditions of approval
    • Measure and improve throughput, cycle time, and review quality

Cover the full range of marketing content subject to review, including:

    • Consumer-facing marketing across paid media, lifecycle and email, web, brand, and social
    • Agent and producer-facing materials, including recruiting, training, and sales support content
    • Partner, carrier, and co-branded campaign materials
    • Product and disclosure content embedded in online flows, including rate and quote presentation and required disclosures

Keep standards evergreen, including:

    • Translate insurance advertising and marketing regulatory change into concrete review criteria, tool rules, and updated approved language
    • Refresh disclosure and claim libraries as products, state approvals, and carrier requirements change

Partner across the business, including:

    • Embed compliance early in the marketing lifecycle, at brief and concept stage rather than at launch
    • Act as trusted advisor and thought leader to Marketing, Brand, Growth, Product, and Legal
    • Partner with the Compliance Risk Management team so that marketing review controls are documented and independently tested
    • Support advertising filings where required, along with market conduct exams, regulatory requests, carrier requests, and data calls
  • Build and lead the function. You will operate as a hands-on player-coach, then hire, onboard, develop, and manage a compliance analyst as volume and automation maturity allow
  • Own marketing compliance reporting and governance, including review volume, cycle time, automation rate, quality and error rates, and KRIs
  • Assist in drafting and updating marketing compliance policies and procedures
  • Provide general compliance support, as needed, across the team and company, including research and provisioning of compliance guidance across Ethos

Qualifications and Skills:

  • 12+ years of relevant Compliance work experience in the insurance industry, including significant hands-on marketing and advertising review experience
  • Deep expertise in insurance regulatory marketing compliance, including advertising requirements, required disclosures, and advertising filing obligations across states
  • Demonstrated ownership of a high-volume marketing or advertising review function, including the standards and the workflow behind it
  • Hands-on experience putting AI or automation to work inside a compliance review workflow - configuring it, measuring it, and improving it, rather than simply using it
  • Ability to define and defend where automation is appropriate and where human judgment is required, and to evidence that distinction to auditors, examiners, and carriers
  • Strong process design instincts, including: intake, SLAs, prioritization, throughput, and cycle time
  • Comfort working with data to measure review quality and automation performance, and to report both to senior leadership
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Persuasive communicator and thought leader who can hold a firm line with Marketing without becoming a bottleneck
  • Be highly responsive and service-oriented, with a demonstrated ability to maintain strong working relationships with demanding internal clients
  • Experience hiring, developing, and managing an analyst, or clear readiness to do so
  • Possess sound and practical business judgment, and confidence in determining acceptable risk
  • Ability to multi-task and work independently or with cross-functional teams, while adapting quickly to ambiguous and rapidly changing environments
  • Attention to detail
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple deadlines

The E.W. Scripps Co is looking for a creative Senior Producer who will work remotely, one-on-one with stations to produce local newscasts. We’re looking for someone who can produce a show with little oversight, and quickly assess the content needs of local news markets across the country. This Producer should have the desire to craft newscasts in new, and innovative ways. The Sr Producer will also work to showcase content on digital platforms. Remote work is approved only for specific geographic locations. This position requires schedule flexibility.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Produce local newscast for stations across Scripps local media markets.

  • Work directly with local station news leadership and other key employees to select the most up-to-date information for the daypart.

  • Exercise solid news judgement and creativity to produce a dynamic product following the Scripps content strategy.

  • Execute time sensitive decisions with independence and clear messaging.

  • Act as an ambassador for the Scripps Content Strategy.

  • Oversee newscast and up-to-the-minute editorial decisions.

  • Be open to sharing ideas on creating content in a new and unique way.

  • Showcase content on local stations digital platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience.

  • Generally 6+ years of experience as a television news producer preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Avid news consumer, knows where to find news and how to get up to speed on local news happening in Scripps markets across the country.

  • Excellent time management skills, highly organized, and deadline-driven.

  • Able to build relationships quickly, communicate assertively, and influence without authority.

  • Experience with editing software in a newsroom environment.

  • Strong critical thinker with the ability to adapt on the fly in challenging situations.

  • Creative and curious to learn new styles of producing news.

  • Exceptional news writing.

  • Working knowledge of journalistic ethics and libel laws.

  • Ability and desire to learn and test new technology.

  • Travel may be required.

  • Flexible work hours are required, including holidays, weekends and evenings

If you are a current Scripps employee, please do not apply on this site. Please access our internal career site at Worklife > My Info > View Open Positions at Scripps.

SCRIPPS’ COMMITMENT TO A CULTURE THAT CREATES CONNECTION:

At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose.

ABOUT SCRIPPS:

The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) is a diversified media company focused on creating connection. As one of the nation’s largest local TV broadcasters, Scripps serves communities with quality, objective local journalism and operates a portfolio of more than 60 stations in 40+ markets. Scripps reaches households across the U.S. with national news outlet Scripps News and popular entertainment brands ION, ION Plus, ION Mystery, Bounce, Grit and Laff. Scripps is the nation’s largest holder of broadcast spectrum. Scripps Sports serves professional and college sports leagues, conferences and teams with local market depth and national broadcast reach of up to 100% of TV households. Founded in 1878, Scripps is the steward of the Scripps National Spelling Bee and its longtime motto is: “Give light and the people will find their own way.”

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team

The Capital Marketplace Vertical is the fuel that powers Upstart’s AI based lending operations. Spread across eight dynamic high performance teams; Capital Marketplace is in charge of onboarding our capital providers, efficiently leveraging the capital on the platform, and maintainingCapital Marketplace relations with both our Lending Partners and Investors. We provide both our internal and external business partners with reports, forecasting, financial reporting and help optimize the connection between our customer base and the funding suppliers.

As a Principal Engineer at Upstart on the Capital Marketplace team, you will collaborate with all parts of the Upstart business and engineering, including Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Product Management, Product Design, Platform, Servicing, Lending Partnerships, and -all product vertical teams. The role will report directly to a head of Capital Market Engineering and work closely with all eight of the Capital Marketplace product engineering teams. Your goal is to autonomously identify and prioritize high impact work that will ultimately make the Capital Marketplace Vertical successful.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Help define the Capital Marketplace engineering’s longer term technical roadmap ensuring alignment with business objectives
  • Guide the architectural evolution of Capital Marketplace systems with an emphasis on systems shared across the Capital Market engineering teams
  • Uncover and drive alignment across complex technical requirements, designs, trade-offs, influencing product direction
  • Proactively evaluate, prototype, and roll out new technologies/frameworks to help cultivate a culture of innovation
  • Partner with product leaders to shape product direction and drive business impact across all Capital Marketplace products
  • Lead from the front, while mentoring and developing technical leaders
  • Identify and prioritize high leverage and impactful opportunities

What we’re looking for:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Mathematics, or a related field (or its equivalent) + 8 years of experience
    • Strong technical and software engineering fundamentals including a demonstrated ability to build and own large-scale, highly available consumer products
    • Ability to explain complex business and technical concepts to all audiences
    • Experience leading large cross-team initiatives at companies that have gone through periods of rapid business or organizational growth
    • Track record of successfully mentoring and developing technical leaders
  • Preferred qualifications:
    • Has defined and executed on longer term (multi-quarter +) technological visions or strategies for multi-team organizations
    • Has driven initiatives of significant depth or breadth with demonstrated results in engineering process, technology platforms, or overall productivity of others
    • Ability to identify gaps in organizational knowledge, tools, and practices and produce and execute on plans to address those gaps
    • Ability to influence and lead without direct authority
    • Strong product and analytical mindset that allows you to think in terms of ROI, risk, and trade offs

Travel Requirements - As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

raw.excerpt: At Qualia, we've built the leading B2B real estate technology that transforms the home buying and selling experience into a simple, secure, and enjoyable process.
raw.description:
At Qualia, we've built the leading B2B real estate technology that transforms the home buying and selling experience into a simple, secure, and enjoyable process. Our SMB and Enterprise products bring together users from across the real estate ecosystem—homebuyers and sellers, lenders, title and escrow agents, and real estate agents—onto a single shared digital closing platform, providing greater clarity and transparency to real estate transactions. Today, through our business customers across the country, millions of consumers use Qualia to close on homes every year.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Within Qualia, you'll join the Payments team. Every real estate closing ends with money changing hands: earnest money deposits, loan funding, mortgage payoffs, seller proceeds, and commissions. Qualia powers a substantial portion of U.S. residential home sales every year, totaling billions of dollars in transaction volume. The Payments team builds the systems that move those funds safely, accurately, and on time.

The stakes are high. A single closing often moves hundreds of thousands of dollars between multiple parties on a tight deadline, and real estate wires are a prime target for fraud. Our mission is to make money movement the most trustworthy part of the closing, so title and escrow teams, and the homebuyers they serve, never have to wonder where their funds are.

HOW WE WORK

Our engineers are entrepreneurial, pragmatic builders who move quickly without cutting corners, and who are as comfortable owning a project end to end as they are collaborating with a team. We ship frequently, as often as multiple times a day, and work directly with design, compliance, and customer-facing teams to build payment experiences our customers depend on.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build, and maintain systems that process ACH and wire transfers at scale (billions of dollars annually), including origination, settlement, reconciliation, and exception handling
  • Build and harden payment-processing pipelines that integrate with banking partners, payment rails, and third-party financial APIs
  • Implement controls for wire fraud prevention, transaction verification, and anomaly detection alongside our security and compliance teams
  • Improve and extend core web applications (frontend and backend) that support escrow accounting and closing-day money movement
  • Own architectural decisions for payments infrastructure, including data integrity, idempotency, retry/failure handling, and audit logging
  • Partner with Compliance, Risk, and Accounting stakeholders to ensure systems meet regulatory and audit requirements (e.g., NACHA rules, wire fraud regulations, SOC 2 controls)
  • Participate in on-call rotation for payment-critical systems

YOUR BACKGROUND THAT LIKELY MAKES YOU A MATCH

  • You've taken full ownership of complex, high-liability systems in production, and you know how to respond calmly and methodically when funds are on the line
  • 5+ years of experience as a strong full-stack web developer is required
  • Direct experience building or maintaining other money-movement systems (banking, fintech, payments processors, or similar regulated environments strongly preferred)
  • Strong understanding of transactional integrity, idempotency, and failure-mode design in financial systems
  • Familiarity with payment rails, banking APIs, or financial compliance standards (NACHA, OFAC screening, PCI, SOC 2) is a strong plus
  • You have made key architectural decisions for large, high-stakes projects
  • You have mentored junior developers
  • You have worked on multiple engineering teams, both small and large
  • Good product sense, strong attention to detail, and a passion for building systems people can trust with their money

THE TECH STACK YOU'LL USE

  • JavaScript / TypeScript / NodeJS
  • SPA Frontend libraries like React and MeteorJS
  • MongoDB
  • Microservice architecture / Kubernetes
  • AWS

We’re always looking for talented individuals who are ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture. As a partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are leaders in loyalty, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.

Join Us from Anywhere

While our headquarters are nestled in sunny St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie embraces a flexible work environment, offering teammates the freedom to work remotely. We understand the importance of work-life balance and support our team with:
·Flexible Time Off to recharge when needed
·Nine Company-Wide Holidays
·A diverse suite of benefits prioritizing your growth, development, and personal well-being
Discover more about our perks and benefits here.
Kobie is a values-led organization where we believe that everyone is a leader, regardless of their position or role.
Travel Requirements:
As a remote-first organization headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie values meaningful in-person connection and collaboration that strengthens our teams, supports our clients, and enhances our culture. While travel requirements vary by role, periodic travel may be required to support business objectives, team collaboration, customer engagements, training, and company events. Candidates should be able and willing to travel as needed to fulfill the responsibilities of the role.

About the team and what we'll build together

    Kobie is a values-led organization where we believe that everyone is a leader, regardless of their position or role. The SA (Solutions Architect) acts as a Kobie SME, investigating client needs through a loyalty lens. They can visualize and articulate client needs, at the intersection of client desired outcomes and Kobie capabilities. They communicate desired client outcomes clearly across workstreams to ensure project success as the enterprise-wide "connective tissue" for a project. During a project, they set the tone for, and manage direction of, the client business solution as they align the team to the associated project scope.

    This role partners closely with Sales, Product, and Delivery, and is remote/hybrid with travel expected up to once per quarter. While it has no direct reports, it owns end-to-end solution scope and cost alignment for standard engagements, setting the bar for solution rigor that other teams rely on.

How you will make an impact

  • Owns Discovery to Define the Right Solution: Elicits and validates business requirements that align client objectives with platform capabilities.
  • Delivers Solution Documentation: Creates and maintains BRDs, SCDs, and Epic/Feature briefs that keep solutions traceable end-to-end.
  • Manages Feasibility and Cost Alignment: Scopes standard engagements independently, coordinating COGS validation across delivery, data, software, CS, and strategy.
  • Aligns Understanding Across Teams: Acts as the connective tissue between business, product, and technical teams throughout each project.
  • Serves as Product and Platform SME: Represents solution expertise in RFPs, RFIs, and upsell conversations.
  • Translates Feedback into Product Direction: Channels client and market insight to shape platform roadmap decisions.
  • Optimizes Sales Enablement: Builds demos, proposals, and pitch materials that establish technical credibility with clients.
  • Owns Solution Acceptance: Maintains design integrity from planning through launch, flagging delivery risks early.
  • Presents Options and Guides Tradeoffs: Helps clients and internal teams weigh scope, cost, and feasibility tradeoffs.
  • Coordinates Pre-Sales to Delivery Handoff: Translates solution intent and decisions so delivery teams avoid rework.
  • Escalates Risk Early: Recognizes when a decision exceeds standard scope and raises it before it becomes a delivery issue.
  • At the End of the First Year, Success Means: Owning solutioning end-to-end, earning trust across Sales, Delivery, and Product, and shaping at least one roadmap decision.

What you need to be successful

    Required

  • 3-5 years of experience in solutions architecture, business requirements analysis, or technical pre-sales within a technology environment.
  • Documents business requirements into BRDs, SCDs, and Epic/Feature briefs that keep solutions traceable from discovery through delivery.
  • Validates delivery cost estimates (COGS) across data/analytics, software, CS, and strategy workstreams to confirm feasibility.
  • Applies Agile/Scrum, waterfall, and iterative delivery methodologies to structure solution plans that fit each client's approach.
  • Builds solution demos, proposals, and pitch materials that establish technical credibility in RFP, RFI, and upsell settings.
  • Coordinates dependencies across marketing, data/analytics, and partner integration workstreams to keep multi-team solutions aligned.
  • Identifies scope drift and delivery risk, translating findings into corrective action plans for delivery and client teams.

    • Strongly Preferred

  • Working knowledge of loyalty marketing programs and mechanics.
  • Delivery experience in retail, financial services, or travel & hospitality.
  • Familiarity with MarTech platforms (e.g., campaign management, CDP, personalization tools) to align solutions with a client's tech stack.
Who we are As a trusted partner, Kobie delivers market-leading, end-to-end loyalty solutions designed to enable customer experiences for the world's most successful brands. We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level. We believe that our team's passion and expertise are the driving forces behind our success and are proud to be named a Top Workplaces in the USA, where the best and brightest in loyalty drive our mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty.
A place for all We celebrate and embrace diversity at Kobie!
Employment at Kobie is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications, which are directly related to professional competence. We do not discriminate against any teammate or applicant because of race,color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
We are fiercely committed to fostering a workplace where teammates can bring their authentic selves to work every day. Our DEI initiatives, including various committees, ensure that principles of equity, diversity, and inclusion are deeply ingrained throughout Kobie. While our leadership team fully supports our policy of nondiscrimination and equal opportunity, it is the responsibility of all teammates to uphold these values.
Ready to join us? If you’re ready to make an impact and grow in a supportive, innovative environment, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and join the best and brightest in loyalty!

raw.description:
Vice President, Global Benefits

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at

The VP, Global Benefits partners with the Head of Total Rewards to execute Circana’s global benefits strategy, and is the primary owner of benefits governance, budget, vendor and broker management, regulatory compliance, and operational delivery. This role is accountable for centralizing benefits delivery currently dispersed across regional HR Business Partner teams into a consistent, governed, enterprise capability, in service of Circana’s HR vision of a simple, proactive, and scalable employee experience.

Working closely with Compensation, Total Rewards leadership, HR Technology, Legal, Payroll, Finance, Procurement, HR Business Partners, and business leaders, this role ensures benefits programs are designed and administered consistently, equitably, competitively, and in compliance with local regulatory requirements across all countries in which Circana operates.

The role provides strategic and operational leadership over the global benefits portfolio, builds the governance model, operating model, and data foundation needed for scalable delivery, and leads a growing team of benefits professionals as the function centralizes. This is a unique opportunity to help build and modernize Circana's global benefits capability at a pivotal stage of growth. This role is best suited for a leader who has successfully built, transformed, or centralized benefits capabilities and can quickly establish credibility, influence, and results in a complex global environment.

This is an evolving role, built for how work should be organized in an AI-enabled function. The leader will architect a global team, including virtual and flexible team members, anchored on the organization's most important priorities (determined through our Business Strategy, HR Mission and Vision, and People Strategy), deliberately elevating team members to complex, judgment-driven, and people-centric work while putting automation and AI to work on repetitive, transactional tasks.

Job Responsibilities

Global Benefits Strategy Partnership

  • Partner with the Head of Total Rewards to shape and execute the global benefits strategy, ensuring programs remain market-competitive, cost-effective, and aligned to Circana’s Total Rewards philosophy and talent priorities.
  • Oversee execution of global benefit design, partnering with the Director, Benefit Design, who owns day-to-day design decisions across health & welfare, retirement/pension, wellbeing, and voluntary benefits.
  • Partner with Compensation on the broader Total Rewards Framework to ensure benefits are positioned consistently with pay philosophy and market positioning.

Transformation & M&A Integration

  • Oversee harmonization of benefits plan design led by the Director, Benefit Design, ensuring outcomes align to enterprise strategy and budget.
  • Provide executive sponsorship for benefits due diligence and integration planning for future M&A activity, partnering with the Director, Benefit Design on design execution.
  • Approve new-country benefit program design led by the Director, Benefit Design, ensuring alignment to global strategy and budget.

Governance & Centralization

  • Build and lead the governance model, standards, decision rights, and operating framework needed to centralize benefits administration currently managed by regional HR Business Partners.
  • Establish and lead the transition plan, timeline, and change management approach for migrating benefits from HRBP teams to a centralized Benefit function.
  • Set the standards for global benefits policies, procedures, and documentation, and govern their consistent application across regions.

Vendor, Broker & Financial Management

  • Own broker, carrier, and third-party administrator relationships and contracts globally for material renewals, partnering with Procurement on RFP mechanics and formal vendor process, and using AI-assisted analysis for renewal-package review and first-pass prep.
  • Lead negotiation and final decisions on broker/carrier renewals and RFP outcomes for material renewals, ensuring service quality and cost discipline; routine renewal documentation and coordination is supported by the Benefits Vendor & Systems Coordinator.
  • Own the global benefits budget; monitor spending, forecast costs, and identify efficiency opportunities in partnership with Finance.

Compliance & Regulatory Governance

  • Ensure compliance with applicable benefits regulations across all countries of operation, including ERISA, ACA, and country-specific statutory requirements.
  • Partner with Legal and Total Rewards on regulatory readiness for initiatives such as the EU Pay Transparency Directive and country-specific benefits mandates (e.g., India).
  • Maintain audit readiness, required filings, and documentation for all benefits programs.

Administration, Systems & Data

  • Ensure end-to-end benefits administration — including enrollment, life events, leave of absence coordination, and escalations — is delivered effectively by the Manager, Benefits – Administration & Delivery, determining outsourcing/co-sourcing opportunities as needed.
  • Partner with HR Technology/EE&T on benefits system configuration, data integrity, and integration with the broader HR technology ecosystem, including the Job Architecture data foundation.
  • Establish benefits reporting and analytics that support decision-making — cost, utilization, and compliance data framed to inform plan renewal, vendor negotiation, and design choices, not just tracked for visibility.
  • Leverage AI and automation to redesign repetitive, transactional benefits processes — enrollment, eligibility, compliance monitoring, and reporting — freeing the team’s capacity for higher-judgment, people-centric work.

Employee Experience & Communication

  • Ensure employee sentiment on benefits satisfaction is monitored and incorporated into program design, led by the Director, Benefit Design.
  • Partner with the Director, Benefit Design, who owns the benefits journey map and end-to-end employee experience strategy, ensuring alignment with Circana’s talent strategy and HR Mission and Vision.
  • Provide executive sponsorship for employee communication, education, and enrollment campaigns led by the Director, Benefit Design, in partnership with HR Business Partners and Talent Management.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex benefits matters, partnering with HR Business Partners during the centralization transition.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Team Leadership

  • Partner with Compensation, Talent Management, Payroll, Legal, Finance, and HR Business Partners to ensure benefits programs support broader Total Rewards and talent strategy.
  • Build and evolve a global team, including virtual and flexible team members, structured around the organization’s most important priorities; deliberately allocating complex, people-centric work to team members and repetitive work to automation and AI as capabilities are built.
  • Partner with Procurement on vendor sourcing, contracting, and cost management strategy for benefits vendors, brokers, and carriers.
  • Leverage partners across the HR organization — including HR Business Partners, Talent Management, and HR Technology — to bring broader expertise and reach global benefits initiatives.
  • Represent Global Benefits in Total Rewards leadership discussions and HRLT initiatives as needed.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of progressive benefits experience, including demonstrated expertise in global benefits design, governance, vendor management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Strong global benefits and regulatory acumen, including deep knowledge of U.S. requirements (ERISA, ACA) and experience navigating multi-country frameworks such as the EU Pay Transparency Directive. Demonstrated experience leading benefits strategy, administration, or governance across multiple countries and regions is required.
  • Fluency in applying AI and automation to redesign operational and administrative processes, with a track record of shifting team capacity from transactional work toward higher-judgment, strategic, and people-centric priorities.
  • Demonstrated experience building, centralizing, harmonizing, or transforming benefits operations, ideally in a multi-country, multi-entity, or post-merger environment.
  • Proven vendor and broker management skills, including RFPs, contract negotiation, and performance governance.
  • Strong financial acumen, with experience owning and managing a global benefits budget.
  • Experience partnering with HR Technology teams on benefits systems, data integrity, and reporting.
  • Excellent communication, consultation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to simplify complex benefits concepts for executive and employee audiences.
  • People leadership experience, with a track record of building and developing high-performing teams, including experience designing flexible, virtual, or hybrid team structures that flex with business priorities.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with a track record of strengthening governance, controls, and scalable benefits solutions that support organizational growth.
  • Experience building new capabilities, operating models, governance structures, or shared-service approaches within a benefits or Total Rewards function.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities with experience leveraging technology and reporting to improve outcomes.

Circana Behaviors

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:

  • Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions.
  • Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action.
  • Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices.
  • Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers.
  • Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement.
  • Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity.
  • Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.

Location:Remote, USA.Candidates must be comfortable supporting a global workforce and working across multiple time zones, including North America and Europe, as needed.

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this position begins at $200,000 USD and will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, and overall alignment with the role. This position is also eligible for an annual bonus.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. Circana uses artificial intelligence (AI) to assess resumes for alignment with job requirements by helping locate details in resumes that relate to the job description.

This position is expected to remain open for approximately 30 days and may close earlier if sufficient qualified candidates are identified.

Busha is Nigeria’s leading regulated crypto exchange. We aim to build an open financial system with innovation, efficiency, and user-friendliness. We value Clear Communication, Positive Energy, Efficient Execution, and Continuous Learning in all our team members.

Role Summary

The Compliance Officer will ensure that Busha’s virtual asset operations in are fully compliant with local and international regulatory requirements. This role will focus on risk management, AML/CFT controls, transaction monitoring, customer due diligence, and operational compliance in the fast-evolving digital financial services space. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to build robust compliance frameworks and processes that protect the business while enabling growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee the end-to-end customer onboarding process for retail and corporate clients, including KYC, KYB, AML/CFT checks, sanctions screening, and enhanced due diligence where necessary.
  • Coordinate and respond to requests from regulators, law enforcement agencies, and industry bodies.
  • Support the licensing and renewal process(es) as may be applicable to Busha.

  • Conduct ongoing compliance reviews, including periodic KYC updates, ongoing monitoring, and risk re-assessments.
  • Lead financial crime investigations, including fraud, sanctions breaches, and suspicious transaction reports (STRs).
  • Develop and implement compliance frameworks, policies, and procedures aligned with applicable Bank guidelines, Anti-Money Laundering Act, and global best practices for virtual assets.

  • Collaborate with Product, Operations, and Support teams to embed compliance into processes and deliver a smooth but compliant customer experience.
  • Conduct internal compliance audits, risk assessments, and periodic testing of systems and controls.
  • Promote a culture of compliance across the organisation through training, awareness, and regular communication.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Economics, Finance, Business, or related field.

  • Strong understanding of Kenya’s’s regulatory landscape for fintech, payment service providers, and virtual asset service providers.
  • Hands-on experience with KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and STR/SAR filing.
  • Knowledge of FATF guidelines, VASP compliance requirements, and financial crime typologies in the digital assets space.

Why Join Us

You will help shape the compliance and risk management culture in our Kenya office, ensuring we grow responsibly and sustainably while staying ahead of evolving regulatory expectations. You will have the support to grow, and the opportunity to be part of something that’s transforming the fintech space in Africa.

Hi!

We are Boosta, a holding tech company that creates, develops, and invests in digital businesses with global potential. Today, we collaborate with over 800 specialists from different parts of the world, and millions of users use our products and services.

We are currently looking for a PPC Specialist (Google Ads: Search / GDN / PMax) for one of our businesses, Traffic7, who will launch and scale the Google Ads web direction for a lead generation product in the financial vertical across Tier-1 markets.

Traffic7 is a project that creates and develops digital products and scales them through strong expertise in performance marketing.

As a PPC Specialist (Google Ads: Search / GDN / PMax), you will work with the team to:

  • Launch and scale the Google Ads web direction (Search, PMax, Demand Gen) for a lead generation product in the financial vertical across Tier-1 markets.
  • Analyze past launches and build a standardized, repeatable web buying process (launch playbook, kill/scale rules).
  • Share expertise with the team: review launches and conduct knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Build account structure, keyword strategy, audiences, and campaign architecture.
  • Set up and maintain conversion tracking end-to-end: GTM, GA4, offline conversion import of sold leads.
  • Optimize toward sold lead / revenue (value-based bidding), not just submitted leads.
  • Plan and run A/B tests: ad copy, creatives, landing pages, bidding strategies.
  • Ensure full compliance with Google Ads financial services policies, handle verification and disapprovals.
  • Control performance daily: spend, CPL, approval rate, ROI, campaigns, and creatives.
  • Prepare regular reports and propose scaling hypotheses.
  • Collaborate with the product, dev, and UAC teams on funnels, landing pages, and insights.
  • Optionally, support Google App Campaigns for Android apps.

You’re a great fit if you:

  • Have 3+ years of hands-on experience with Google Ads web campaigns: Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen.
  • Have experience in regulated / high-competition verticals (finance, lending, insurance, lead generation).
  • Have strong knowledge of Google Ads policies for financial services, including advertiser verification, disapproval handling, and appeals.
  • Have experience setting up conversion tracking: GA4, GTM, enhanced conversions, offline conversion import (gclid-based).
  • Have experience with bidding strategies (tCPA, tROAS, Maximize Conversions) and value-based bidding.
  • Have experience working with landing pages / prelanders: briefs to dev/design, A/B testing, CR optimization.
  • Have a data-driven approach and understand unit economics (CPC, CPL, CPA, EPL, ROI) and regular reporting.
  • Have proven experience launching and scaling campaigns with monthly budgets of $100K+.
  • Have experience managing $100K+/month in Google Ads web campaigns with positive ROAS.
  • Have experience building buying processes / playbooks or mentoring other media buyers.

Will be a plus:

  • Experience with Google App Campaigns (UAC / ACi) for Android apps.
  • Experience with Tier-1 markets and understanding of local targeting requirements and restrictions.
  • Experience with BI dashboards (Looker Studio, Tableau, Funnel).
  • Experience using AI tools for creatives, ad copy, and analytics.

Our hiring flow:

  • Step 1. Pre-screen.
  • Step 2. Interview.
  • Step 3. Final interview.
  • Step 4. Reference check.
  • Step 5. Job Offer.

More than 7 opportunities we offer:

  • Work and growth in an environment where you can launch, test, and develop new products, see your direct results, and influence them.
  • Support for your career growth: compensation for external courses, conferences, English language classes and access to a corporate library.
  • Flexible working hours (you can start your day between 8:00 and 11:00 Kyiv time).
  • Office in Kyiv, coworking spaces in Lviv and Warsaw, or the option to work remotely — the choice is yours.
  • 28 days of annual vacation, up to 30 days of sick leave with medical confirmation, plus all public holidays.
  • Care for your health: medical insurance, a Mental Health program, and compensation for sessions with a psychologist.
  • Ukrainian Victory Support program and other important social initiatives.
  • Gifts for special occasions in your life and career.
  • Compensation for equipment during blackouts.

We believe in pace, drive, and daily boosts — in our work, approaches, and ourselves.

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

The role of a Senior CRO Copywriter focuses on creating persuasive, conversion-driven copy with the primary goal of improving marketing performance and conversion rates. This involves developing compelling copy for landing pages, ads, video scripts, and other marketing assets that attract cold audiences and encourage them to take action.

The CRO Copywriter works closely with marketing, creative, and testing teams to develop and optimize messaging based on customer research, campaign performance, and A/B testing results. Key tasks include developing new copy and messaging angles, researching audiences and competitors, analyzing copy performance, and continuously testing and refining copy to improve conversion metrics.

Responsibilities

  • Create conversion-focused copy for cold-traffic campaigns across landing pages, paid ads, video scripts, advertorials, forms, CTAs, and other funnel assets.
  • Research products, customers, competitors, markets, and advertising trends to identify new messaging opportunities.
  • Develop compelling headlines, hooks, offers, value propositions, benefits, and creative angles, translating technical product features into clear customer-focused messaging.
  • Ensure advertising claims are accurate, supportable, and compliant with client and platform requirements.
  • Create meaningful copy variations for structured A/B testing, analyze performance, and continuously iterate based on results.
  • Identify successful copy concepts and adapt them across similar clients, products, and industries.
  • Contribute winning concepts, failed tests, research, and learnings to the company's copywriting knowledge base.
  • Collaborate in brainstorming sessions with Marketers, Designers, Video Editors, Media Buyers, and other team members.
  • Use AI tools in the copywriting workflow to improve research, ideation, analysis, and production efficiency.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Direct Response Copywriting, Performance Copywriting, Advertising Copywriting, or a similar conversion-focused role.
  • Native-level English.
  • Strong understanding of direct-response principles, customer psychology, and conversion-focused writing.
  • Proven experience writing landing pages, paid advertising copy, and performance creative.
  • Strong ability to develop headlines, hooks, offers, CTAs, value propositions, and messaging angles.
  • Experience writing for cold audiences and customer acquisition campaigns.
  • Ability to quickly research and understand unfamiliar products, markets, and customer segments.
  • Ability to translate features and technical information into clear customer benefits.
  • Experience creating structured copy variations for A/B testing.
  • Comfortable reviewing marketing performance data and using results to improve copy.
  • Strong attention to detail, grammar, proofreading, and consistency.
  • Ability to manage multiple clients, niches, and projects simultaneously.
  • Experience using AI tools for research, copy development, analysis, and workflow optimization.

Soft skills

  • Curious to explore new tools, formats, and creative approaches.
  • Adaptability to shifting priorities and fast-paced team dynamics.
  • High execution speed without compromising quality.
  • Consistent on-time delivery and attention to deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail, especially when adhering to compliance and brand guidelines.
  • Critical thinking and a problem-solving mindset.
  • Clear, professional communication and team collaboration skills.
  • Initiative to find solutions even when processes are undefined.
  • Strong work ethic, self-motivation, and a drive to exceed expectations.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office -we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well–Being - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:

Are you ready to level up from building basic AI agents to crafting game-changing solutions? We're looking for a talented AI Agent Engineer who's already gotten their hands dirty with LLMs and is ready to make their mark in cybersecurity.
You'll be at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and enterprise-scale impact, building agents that actually ship and make a difference. This isn't about theoretical AI – it's about creating solutions that protect organizations worldwide.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the full lifecycle: from prototype to production deployment

  • Lead development of AI agents using modern frameworks (vLLM, SGLang)

  • Optimize agent performance through prompt engineering and fine-tuning

  • Design scalable solutions that balance cost, performance, and security

  • Collaborate with teams to transform enterprise workflows

Your Technical Foundation Should Include:

Agent Development:

Core Skills:​

  • Strong Python chops

  • Familiarity with deployment frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, FastAPI

  • Experience with modern LLM platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • You've built and shipped AI agents beyond tutorial projects

  • You're comfortable with rapid prototyping and iteration

  • You understand the importance of AI safety and responsible development

  • You can explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

  • You're eager to learn and adapt as AI technology evolves

  • Portfolio of agent projects you can walk us through

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

  • You've worked with production ML/AI systems

  • You're curious about cybersecurity

Ready to build something meaningful? Let's talk about your agent building experience and where you want to take it next.
