raw.title: Sr. Product Manager- Processing
raw.excerpt: Who We Are Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.

Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and cut carbon.

We deliver this through three comprehensive solutions:

  • Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
  • Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. .
  • Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.

Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.

What we’re looking for:

We're looking for a product leader who is equally fluent in-service operations and technology product management to own Processing. You will define and execute the roadmap that normalizes and validates bill data at scale, and — critically — you will lead the transformation of a labor-intensive, legacy processing ecosystem into an AI- and automation-first operation. Understanding customer needs and market competition informs the roadmap to win in this market.

This means owning service labor optimization as a first-class product problem: understanding where manual bill entry, credential handling, and exception review consume cost and introduce error, and systematically replacing that labor with AI extraction, agentic automation, and modern tooling. The outcome is a lower cost per bill processed, healthier margins, and pricing that lets Arcadia go to market more competitively.

Arcadia is open to fully remote candidates and employees have access to co-working spaces.

What you'll do:

Processing Product & Service Roadmap

Bill Data Normalization & Validation: Own the roadmap for normalizing and validating raw bill data delivered by Plug into clean, structured payables, partnering with the data platform team on upstream data-quality feedback loops.

Service Labor Optimization: Partner with Operations leadership overseeing tariff analysts, manual bill entry, and credential handling teams to map today's most labor-intensive workflows, quantify their cost and error rates, and prioritize which to automate first.

AI & Agentic Automation: Define and drive adoption of AI-powered extraction, document processing, and agentic automation across a legacy, service-heavy ecosystem — reducing dependence on manual review while holding or improving accuracy.

Tolerancing & Exception Handling: Own the roadmap for provider-specific tolerancing rules and exception-handling logic that shrink the volume of bills routed to manual review.

Margin & Pricing Strategy: Build the business case connecting automation investment to cost-per-bill-processed improvement and translate margin gains into more competitive list pricing and packaging for go-to-market.

Legacy System Modernization: Plan and sequence the migration of processing workflows off legacy and acquired systems onto modern, automation-first tooling — without disrupting live customer operations.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Payments Alignment: Ensure Processing reliably generates clean payables that feed Payments— every downstream payment depends on the quality of Processing's output.

Retention Protection: Identify and close data quality gaps and processing errors before they become churn events.

Roadmap Execution: Maintain a prioritized, initiative-aligned roadmap with clear epics, due dates, and OKR traceability; represent Processing in cross-functional planning with Commercial, Operations, and R&D.

What will help you succeed:

Must-haves:

Service + Technology Product Management: Proven experience owning products where the “system” includes both software and a human service operation — comfortable being accountable for a service delivery model, not just a software roadmap.

Service Labor Optimization: Track record of redesigning labor-intensive, service-heavy workflows (manual data entry, exception queues, offshore/BPO operations) into automated or AI-assisted processes, with measurable cost-per-unit improvement.

AI & Agentic Product Experience: Hands-on experience shipping AI-powered document processing, extraction, or agentic automation features into production.

Legacy Modernization: Experience modernizing or migrating workflows off legacy or acquired systems while maintaining operational continuity for live customers.

Margin & Pricing Fluency: Comfortable building business cases that connect automation and unit economics to gross margin and go-to-market pricing decisions.

Domain Familiarity: Experience with document/data extraction, validation logic, or high-volume back-office and transaction processing (utility billing or invoice processing a plus).

Experience: 6+ years of product management experience, including experience managing products with an embedded service or operations component.

NICE TO HAVE:

Experience integrating or modernizing service operations gained through M&A (e.g., legacy platforms, outsourced processing vendors).

Background in utility billing, invoice processing, or high-volume transaction environments

Benefits:

  • "Remote first" culture - work anywhere in the continental US as long as you have a reliable internet connection
  • Flexible PTO - no accrued hours and no limit on the number of vacation days exempt employees can take each year
  • 11 annual holidays
  • 10 days sick leave
  • Up to 2 weeks bereavement leave
  • 2 volunteer days off
  • 2 professional development days off
  • Parental Leave Benefits for ALL parents
  • 75-95% employer cost coverage for medical, dental, and vision benefits for employees and dependents
  • A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency

Celebrating Diversity and Inclusion

Here at Arcadia, we cultivate diversity, celebrate individuality, and believe unique perspectives are key to our collective success in creating a clean energy future. Arcadia is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation by emailing prior to completing your application.

Target Annual Compensation Range for this role will be $160,000 to $230,000. There will also be a competitive benefits and equity (bonus if applicable) component to the package. The exact compensation at which this job is filled will be determined by the skills, experience, and location of the qualified candidate. Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

Automated Screening: Arcadia uses AI-assisted technology to evaluate candidates on relevant skills, experience, and education as outlined in the job description. raw.description:
This is a part-time position. Since the AoPS Academy Virtual Campus is an after-school and weekend enrichment option for students, most of our Year-Round courses are offered late afternoons to evenings Monday through Friday.

This might be a good fit if you:

  • Are a rock-star teacher with a passion for working with high-achieving students
  • Are an engaging, enthusiastic instructor who can motivate gifted learners
  • Have strong content knowledge in reading, writing, and grammar
  • Aren’t afraid of student-led instruction, discussions, and allowing students to do the heavy lifting
  • Foster a virtual classroom environment that encourages critical thinking and problem solving
  • Have strong writing skills and can give thoughtful, thorough feedback on students’ writing assignments
  • Are comfortable teaching in a live virtual classroom environment
  • Have an interest in teaching elementary through middle school levels

For each lesson you will:

  • Teach enthusiastic elementary and/or middle school students in our online classrooms.
  • Use our curriculum to teach participation-oriented classes that focus on instruction and developing skills, not on rote memorization.
  • Work in small classes (average size 12) with top performing students who are passionate about learning and are motivated to succeed.

Requirements:

  • Must have a solid academic background in English and language arts.
  • A bachelor’s degree in a humanities field is required, ideally related to language arts. A master’s degree or higher is preferred.
  • Must have some experience using Zoom or similar video conferencing software and be comfortable managing a classroom in a virtual setting.
  • Must have experience teaching or tutoring students at the K-12 level. Classroom teaching experience and some experience working with advanced students is preferred.
  • All functions of this role must be completed in the U.S.

Benefits and Compensation:

The instructor rate at the Virtual Campus is $30/hour for Year-Round classes. The class rates represent flexible work time, 15 minutes early arrival immediately before class, and actual class time.

  • Paid Sick Leave*
  • 401K retirement plan
  • Employee discount on classes and Beast Academy Online (BAO) yearly subscriptions

*Not applicable to all states

At this time we are only hiring instructors who are currently located in and authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to offer sponsorship, including STEM-OPT and H-1B.

AoPS Academy is a program of Art of Problem Solving (AoPS), a global leader in K–12 advanced education. AoPS is on a mission to discover, inspire, and train the great problem solvers of the next generation. Since 2003, AoPS has trained hundreds of thousands of the country’s top students through its online school, in-person academies, textbooks, and online learning systems. AoPS Academy offers unique problem solving curriculum at its in-person locations across the country as well as through the virtual campus.

Just like our traditional AoPS Academy experience, our range of language arts course offerings at the AoPS Academy Virtual Campus allows students in grades 2-12 the opportunity to explore new interests while strengthening their reading, writing, listening, speaking, and critical thinking skills.

With small class sizes and a virtual classroom setting that allows participants to see and talk to each other in real time via Zoom, our students will have access to some of the most highly accomplished instructors in the nation, and we want you to be one of them!

raw.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Talent Technology team. This role will play a key part in shaping and executing the roadmap for our internal talent systems. You’ll partner closely with engineering, design, data science, and stakeholders across HR and business functions to deliver seamless, scalable experiences that support the full employee lifecycle: from candidate experience to employee growth and retention. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in a cross-functional environment and is excited to work hands-on with engineering and business partners to deliver meaningful outcomes. This role will go deep into talent data systems and architecture to be able to lay the foundation for AI initiatives and a broader talent ecosystem strategy.

About You:

You are curious and creative, and have experience applying product management frameworks to create enterprise or consumer products. You are highly adaptable and when faced with challenges, you become more creative, not less. You like solving problems and can drive clarity to build the optimal products. You are biased toward execution and can lead the team to bring projects from concept to completion, doing everything possible to ensure a successful launch. You are data-driven with a knack for using data to identify business opportunities, have a can-do attitude, are confident, and a skilled communicator who welcomes honest and candid feedback. You are comfortable working with engineers, customers, and executives and know how to articulate your communication to each audience effectively.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for talent management systems, including but not limited to our custom solutions for studio workforce management and feedback & performance.

  • Deeply understand the needs of HR stakeholders, people leaders, and employees through research, data analysis, and close partnership.

  • Translate complex business problems and talent strategies into intuitive, user-focused product experiences.

  • Prioritize competing demands from stakeholders across the organization using a clear, strategic framework.

  • Partner closely with engineering and design teams to deliver high-quality product experiences and solutions on time and at scale.

  • Monitor product performance, adoption, and satisfaction using data and use these insights to continuously improve.

  • Stay current on market trends in HR tech and bring new thinking into our product approach.

  • Lead product discussions with senior HR, engineering and business leaders, influencing strategic direction.

  • Have a deep understanding and empathy for customer needs, using user research and creative feedback mechanisms to validate product hypotheses and optimal product solutions.

  • Be driven to explore advanced AI and large language concepts, and their potential applications in an evolving Talent Technology space.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree.

  • 6+ years of product management and/or data architecture experience with a strong track record in enterprise applications or HR/Talent technology.

  • Brings a deep appreciation for the complexity and nuance of the talent domain, including the systems and processes that support employee lifecycle events.Knowledge of Talent Data systems and experience developing analytical systems around talent data lakes.

  • Experience with GenAI and working with core engineering teams

  • Comfortable collaborating with engineers and making tradeoffs based on technical considerations and business priorities

  • Ability to operate strategically, envisioning scalable solutions, while also diving deep with engineers into edge cases, technical tradeoffs, and implementation details.

  • Familiarity with the talent ecosystem: learning systems (LMS), employee engagement

  • Self-directed and comfortable operating in a decentralized, fast-paced environment

  • Empathy for internal users and ability to turn business needs into delightful product experiences.

  • Lead product requirements, technical development, product testing, launch, end-user training, and rollout.

  • Ability to drive and influence business decisions based on data and metrics.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $310,000.00 - $545,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

raw.description:
The React (Next.js) Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, high-performance web applications using React.js and Next.js. This role involves building production-ready features, integrating with backend/BFF APIs, ensuring high code quality, and implementing best practices in performance, accessibility, and security.

The developer will work closely with the React Lead, UX/UI designers, QA, DevOps, and backend teams to deliver modern web applications aligned with enterprise architecture and business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Frontend Development

  • Develop responsive, interactive, and accessible web pages using React.js and Next.js.
  • Implement server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), and incremental static regeneration (ISR) as required.
  • Build reusable components, custom hooks, and libraries.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness.

2. Next.js Framework Implementation

  • Utilize Next.js features effectively:
    • getServerSideProps, getStaticProps, getStaticPaths
    • API routes and middleware
    • Dynamic routing, layouts, and nested routes
  • Optimize hydration, lazy-loading, and client/server data fetching.
  • Implement efficient caching and prefetching strategies for faster UX.

3. State Management & Data Handling

  • Manage application state using Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Recoil, or Context API + Hooks.
  • Integrate with REST or GraphQL APIs from BFF/backend layers.
  • Handle errors, loading states, and fallback UI for smoother user experiences.

4. UI/UX & Design System Integration

  • Work with designers to implement pixel-perfect UIs aligned with the enterprise design system.
  • Integrate components from Storybook or other design libraries.
  • Implement accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and responsive design best practices.

5. Performance Optimization

  • Monitor and optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS).
  • Reduce bundle size using code splitting, lazy loading, and tree shaking.
  • Optimize rendering performance and memory usage.

6. Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Write unit and integration tests using:
    • Jest
    • React Testing Library
  • Support end-to-end testing with Cypress or Playwright.
  • Participate in code reviews and maintain high-quality, maintainable code.

7. Security & Best Practices

  • Implement secure coding practices (input validation, XSS prevention, secure storage of tokens).
  • Follow best practices for API integration, routing, and data handling.
  • Collaborate with security teams to comply with enterprise security policies.

8. Collaboration & Agile Practices

  • Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate closely with React Lead, QA, DevOps, backend/BFF developers, and product teams.
  • Communicate technical challenges and propose solutions clearly.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 5+ years experience in frontend development.
  • Strong expertise in:
    • React.js (Hooks, Context, Custom Hooks)
    • Next.js (SSR, SSG, ISR, Routing, API routes)
    • TypeScript
    • HTML5, CSS3, Sass, Styled Components, Tailwind CSS
  • Experience with:
    • State management (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Recoil)
    • RESTful APIs / GraphQL
    • Performance optimization and debugging
    • Unit & integration testing frameworks (Jest, RTL)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern build tools (Webpack, Vite).

Soft Skills

  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to debug complex issues.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Detail-oriented with focus on high-quality, maintainable code.

Education & Background

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Portfolio of web applications using React and Next.js preferred.

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

The role of a Senior CRO Copywriter focuses on creating persuasive, conversion-driven copy with the primary goal of improving marketing performance and conversion rates. This involves developing compelling copy for landing pages, ads, video scripts, and other marketing assets that attract cold audiences and encourage them to take action.

The CRO Copywriter works closely with marketing, creative, and testing teams to develop and optimize messaging based on customer research, campaign performance, and A/B testing results. Key tasks include developing new copy and messaging angles, researching audiences and competitors, analyzing copy performance, and continuously testing and refining copy to improve conversion metrics.

Responsibilities

  • Create conversion-focused copy for cold-traffic campaigns across landing pages, paid ads, video scripts, advertorials, forms, CTAs, and other funnel assets.

Who We Are

Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.

Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and cut carbon.

We deliver this through three comprehensive solutions:

  • Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
  • Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. .
  • Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.

Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.

What we’re looking for:

We're looking for a product leader who is equally fluent in-service operations and technology product management to own Processing. You will define and execute the roadmap that normalizes and validates bill data at scale, and — critically — you will lead the transformation of a labor-intensive, legacy processing ecosystem into an AI- and automation-first operation. Understanding customer needs and market competition informs the roadmap to win in this market.

This means owning service labor optimization as a first-class product problem: understanding where manual bill entry, credential handling, and exception review consume cost and introduce error, and systematically replacing that labor with AI extraction, agentic automation, and modern tooling. The outcome is a lower cost per bill processed, healthier margins, and pricing that lets Arcadia go to market more competitively.

Arcadia is open to fully remote candidates and employees have access to co-working spaces.

What you'll do:

Processing Product & Service Roadmap

Bill Data Normalization & Validation: Own the roadmap for normalizing and validating raw bill data delivered by Plug into clean, structured payables, partnering with the data platform team on upstream data-quality feedback loops.

Service Labor Optimization: Partner with Operations leadership overseeing tariff analysts, manual bill entry, and credential handling teams to map today's most labor-intensive workflows, quantify their cost and error rates, and prioritize which to automate first.

AI & Agentic Automation: Define and drive adoption of AI-powered extraction, document processing, and agentic automation across a legacy, service-heavy ecosystem — reducing dependence on manual review while holding or improving accuracy.

Tolerancing & Exception Handling: Own the roadmap for provider-specific tolerancing rules and exception-handling logic that shrink the volume of bills routed to manual review.

Margin & Pricing Strategy: Build the business case connecting automation investment to cost-per-bill-processed improvement and translate margin gains into more competitive list pricing and packaging for go-to-market.

Legacy System Modernization: Plan and sequence the migration of processing workflows off legacy and acquired systems onto modern, automation-first tooling — without disrupting live customer operations.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Payments Alignment: Ensure Processing reliably generates clean payables that feed Payments— every downstream payment depends on the quality of Processing's output.

Retention Protection: Identify and close data quality gaps and processing errors before they become churn events.

Roadmap Execution: Maintain a prioritized, initiative-aligned roadmap with clear epics, due dates, and OKR traceability; represent Processing in cross-functional planning with Commercial, Operations, and R&D.

What will help you succeed:

Must-haves:

Service + Technology Product Management: Proven experience owning products where the “system” includes both software and a human service operation — comfortable being accountable for a service delivery model, not just a software roadmap.

Service Labor Optimization: Track record of redesigning labor-intensive, service-heavy workflows (manual data entry, exception queues, offshore/BPO operations) into automated or AI-assisted processes, with measurable cost-per-unit improvement.

AI & Agentic Product Experience: Hands-on experience shipping AI-powered document processing, extraction, or agentic automation features into production.

Legacy Modernization: Experience modernizing or migrating workflows off legacy or acquired systems while maintaining operational continuity for live customers.

Margin & Pricing Fluency: Comfortable building business cases that connect automation and unit economics to gross margin and go-to-market pricing decisions.

Domain Familiarity: Experience with document/data extraction, validation logic, or high-volume back-office and transaction processing (utility billing or invoice processing a plus).

Experience: 6+ years of product management experience, including experience managing products with an embedded service or operations component.

NICE TO HAVE:

Experience integrating or modernizing service operations gained through M&A (e.g., legacy platforms, outsourced processing vendors).

Background in utility billing, invoice processing, or high-volume transaction environments

This role involves building production-ready features, integrating with backend/BFF APIs, ensuring high code quality, and implementing best practices in performance, accessibility, and security.

The developer will work closely with the React Lead, UX/UI designers, QA, DevOps, and backend teams to deliver modern web applications aligned with enterprise architecture and business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Frontend Development

  • Develop responsive, interactive, and accessible web pages using React.js and Next.js.
  • Implement server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), and incremental static regeneration (ISR) as required.
  • Build reusable components, custom hooks, and libraries.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness.

2. Next.js Framework Implementation

  • Utilize Next.js features effectively:
    • getServerSideProps, getStaticProps, getStaticPaths
    • API routes and middleware
    • Dynamic routing, layouts, and nested routes
  • Optimize hydration, lazy-loading, and client/server data fetching.
  • Implement efficient caching and prefetching strategies for faster UX.

3. State Management & Data Handling

  • Manage application state using Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Recoil, or Context API + Hooks.
  • Integrate with REST or GraphQL APIs from BFF/backend layers.
  • Handle errors, loading states, and fallback UI for smoother user experiences.

4. UI/UX & Design System Integration

  • Work with designers to implement pixel-perfect UIs aligned with the enterprise design system.
  • Integrate components from Storybook or other design libraries.
  • Implement accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and responsive design best practices.

5. Performance Optimization

  • Monitor and optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS).
  • Reduce bundle size using code splitting, lazy loading, and tree shaking.
  • Optimize rendering performance and memory usage.

6. Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Write unit and integration tests using:
    • Jest
    • React Testing Library
  • Support end-to-end testing with Cypress or Playwright.
  • Participate in code reviews and maintain high-quality, maintainable code.

7. Security & Best Practices

  • Implement secure coding practices (input validation, XSS prevention, secure storage of tokens).
  • Follow best practices for API integration, routing, and data handling.
  • Collaborate with security teams to comply with enterprise security policies.

8. Collaboration & Agile Practices

  • Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate closely with React Lead, QA, DevOps, backend/BFF developers, and product teams.
  • Communicate technical challenges and propose solutions clearly.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 5+ years experience in frontend development.
  • Strong expertise in:
    • React.js (Hooks, Context, Custom Hooks)
    • Next.js (SSR, SSG, ISR, Routing, API routes)
    • TypeScript
    • HTML5, CSS3, Sass, Styled Components, Tailwind CSS
  • Experience with:
    • State management (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Recoil)
    • RESTful APIs / GraphQL
    • Performance optimization and debugging
    • Unit & integration testing frameworks (Jest, RTL)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern build tools (Webpack, Vite).

Soft Skills

  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to debug complex issues.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Detail-oriented with focus on high-quality, maintainable code.

Education & Background

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Portfolio of web applications using React and Next.js preferred.

This is a remote position.

Role:Head of AI Enablement & Transformation
Company:Vulcury Consulting
Location:Flexible (U.S. preferred; remote with periodic collaboration)
Compensation:Base + revenue share + equity participation tied to practice performance

About Vulcury Consulting

Vulcury Consulting is the advisory and execution arm ofVulcury, a venture studio and consulting platform that builds and scales sophisticated businesses. Our consulting practice supports both external clients and internally incubated ventures across strategy, technology, operations, and growth.

Unlike traditional consultancies that focus on slide decks and recommendations, Vulcury is structured todesign and implement real systemsthat drive measurable business outcomes.

One of the most significant opportunities today isAI transformation—the replacement or augmentation of legacy software and manual workflows through agentic systems, intelligent automation, and modern AI infrastructure. Vulcury is building a dedicated practice focused on delivering these capabilities to clients.

The Opportunity

Vulcury is seeking aHead of AI Enablement & Transformationto build and lead our AI implementation practice.

This role is effectively the leader of atechnology implementation consultancy focused on deploying AI solutions. The practice will design and implement systems such as:

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate knowledge work

  • AI copilots that augment existing teams

  • AI-native tools replacing legacy SaaS platforms

  • AI-powered operational automation across departments

In many cases, Vulcury will bebuilding custom AI systems for clients, integrating LLMs, orchestration layers, APIs, and internal data systems.

The person in this role will lead bothclient development and delivery, building a profitable consulting vertical while leveraging Vulcury’s infrastructure, talent network, and venture studio ecosystem.

The role is designed for someonea few years out of an MBA or strategy/technology consulting careerwho recognizes that the traditional partnership track at large firms can take a decade. Instead, this person is excited tobuild a practice now, operating with significant autonomy and sharing directly in the upside created.

While candidates may eventually have built their own AI consultancy, the ideal person prefers toaccelerate that journey within Vulcury’s platform, gaining access to delivery infrastructure, technical collaborators, and an existing client ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

Build and Lead the AI Transformation Practice

  • Establish and lead Vulcury’s AI enablement and transformation practice.

  • Define service offerings around:

    • Agentic workflow design and deployment

    • AI automation of operational processes

    • Replacement of legacy SaaS tools with AI-native systems

    • AI copilots for internal teams

    • AI infrastructure integration with existing data systems

  • Develop repeatable frameworks for assessing AI opportunities inside client organizations.

Client Development

  • Bring an initialclient network or book of businesswhere possible.

  • Develop new client relationships through thought leadership, partnerships, and targeted outreach.

  • Identify AI transformation opportunities within Vulcury’s consulting and venture studio ecosystem.

Solution Design & Delivery

  • Lead the design of AI-enabled workflows and systems for client organizations.

  • Coordinate with Vulcury engineers, analysts, and technical specialists to build solutions.

  • Oversee deployment, testing, and iteration of AI systems within client environments.

Practice Economics

  • Own theP&L of the AI transformation practice.

  • Develop scalable delivery models combining advisory, engineering, and implementation.

  • Recruit and mentor technical consultants and AI specialists as the practice grows.

Advisory Strength in Agentic AI

The AI enablement practice will be supported by advisory input from asenior leader in agentic AI at a global financial institution, providing strategic perspective on emerging architectures and enterprise adoption patterns.

This relationship ensures the practice remains aligned withcutting-edge developments in AI-driven operational transformation.

What Makes This Different

This is not a traditional consulting job.

You will be:

  • Building and owning a new consulting practice

  • Delivering real AI systems rather than theoretical transformation plans

  • Leveraging Vulcury’s infrastructure rather than building from scratch

  • Participating directly in the upside you create

Instead of spending a decade navigating a consulting partnership track, this role offers the opportunity tobuild a high-value AI consulting franchise immediately.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is structured to reflect the entrepreneurial nature of the role.

Components may include:

  • Competitive base salary

  • Revenue share from AI consulting engagements

  • Equity or profit participation tied to practice performance

  • Participation in broader Vulcury upside depending on long-term role

Top performers in this role should expect compensationclosely aligned with the value they create for clients and the practice.

​

Requirements

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for abuilder who understands both consulting and modern AI capabilities.

Typical background may include:

  • MBA from a leading program

  • 3–7 years experience in one or more of:

    • Strategy consulting

    • Technology consulting or digital transformation

    • AI implementation within a startup or enterprise

    • Building or deploying AI tools internally

  • Familiarity with modern AI architecture including:

    • LLM-based systems

    • agentic workflows

    • automation platforms

    • API integrations

  • Experience working with executive stakeholders on technology initiatives

  • Demonstrated ability to originate business or manage client relationships

The ideal candidate likely:

  • Has begun buildingclient relationships or advisory engagements

  • Recognizes the limits of large consulting firms

  • Is motivated byownership and autonomy

  • Wants to build a practice with real economic participation


Benefits

Why Join Vulcury

Vulcury is designed as a platform for builders.

You will have access to:

  • A venture studio launching new technology businesses

  • Existing consulting infrastructure and delivery teams

  • A network of engineers, analysts, and operators

  • Opportunities to design and deploy cutting-edge AI systems

For the right person, this role is an opportunity tobuild a modern AI implementation consultancy with meaningful ownership and long-term upside.

We are seeking a Mobile App Developer for a one-time, project-based engagement focused on the enhancement, optimization, and improvement of an existing mobile application.

The developer will be responsible for assessing the current application and its codebase, identifying performance issues and areas for improvement, implementing approved enhancements, and ensuring that existing functionalities remain stable and reliable. The role will involve debugging, code optimization, API integration, performance testing, and resolution of identified technical issues.

Responsibilities

  • Review and assess the existing mobile application's source code, architecture, functionality, and overall performance.
  • Identify technical issues, performance bottlenecks, bugs, and areas requiring improvement.
  • Enhance and optimize existing mobile application features based on the approved project requirements.
  • Improve application speed, responsiveness, stability, and overall user experience.
  • Refactor and optimize existing code to improve maintainability, efficiency, and performance.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve existing application bugs, crashes, errors, and technical issues.
  • Review and improve existing API integrations, database interactions, and backend connectivity, where applicable.
  • Implement approved enhancements and modifications without compromising existing application functionality.
  • Conduct functional, regression, compatibility, and performance testing after implementing enhancements.
  • Ensure that existing features remain operational following modifications and optimizations.
  • Identify potential technical risks and recommend practical solutions or improvements.
  • Prepare the optimized application build for deployment or release, where applicable.
  • Maintain proper version control of the modified source code.
  • Provide technical documentation covering the implemented changes and relevant technical recommendations.
  • Turn over the updated source code, documentation, credentials/access required for the project, and other agreed deliverables upon completion.
  • Provide agreed post-project support for identified bugs or issues arising from the completed enhancements.
  • Complete all project deliverables within the agreed project timeline and acceptance criteria.
Desirable Skills and Experiences
Must-haves
  • Proven experience in mobile application enhancement, maintenance, or optimization.
  • Demonstrable experience working with an existing mobile application or codebase.
  • Portfolio or relevant project samples showing previous mobile application development work.
  • Proficiency in at least one of the following:
    • Flutter / Dart
    • React Native / JavaScript / TypeScript
    • Android / Kotlin / Java
    • iOS / Swift
  • Experience with API integration and backend connectivity.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
  • Knowledge of application performance optimization and code refactoring.
  • Ability to understand and work with an existing codebase rather than developing an application entirely from scratch.
  • Willingness to provide the updated source code, technical documentation, and complete project turnover upon completion.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience optimizing applications with existing users or production deployments.
  • Experience resolving application crashes, slow performance, memory issues, and compatibility problems.
  • Experience with Firebase Crashlytics, Firebase Analytics, or similar monitoring tools.
  • Experience with CI/CD and automated testing.
  • Experience with Google Play Store and/or Apple App Store deployment.
  • Experience optimizing API calls, database queries, and network performance.
  • Experience working with legacy or previously developed mobile applications.
  • Relevant degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Associate Project Manager

100% Remote · Anywhere in Canada · Full-time

inecta makes inecta Food — a purpose-built ERP for food and beverage manufacturers, processors, and distributors. Our clients run some of the most complex supply chains in the industry, and we help them run them better.

We're hiring an Associate Project Manager to support the delivery of inecta Food implementations alongside our senior project management team. This is a growth role, not a standalone one — you'll execute against the plan under guidance while building the experience to run engagements of your own. The goal is simple: keep projects on track, keep clients and stakeholders informed, and take on more ownership as you go.

Responsibilities

Client Handling

  • Promotes and maintains positive client relationships that directly serve inecta's profitability and strategic goals.
  • Ensures all actions are aligned with inecta's best interests, recognizing the importance of retaining profitable reference clients.
  • Proactively and effectively manages client expectations.
  • Communicates effectively and respectfully with clients.
  • Flags concerns or complaints appropriately and maintains clear expectations.
  • Involvement in upselling inecta product to current customers.

Plan Driven Project Execution

  • Ensures proactive, plan-driven project execution across assigned projects by using the project plan as the authoritative guide for tasks and timelines.
  • Drives accountability by ensuring assigned resources complete tasks as scheduled, with timely status updates reflecting actual progress.

Risk Management & Communication

  • Assesses with guidance and escalates risks appropriately, keeping stakeholders informed.
  • With guidance from senior resources, identifies potential deviations early and takes corrective action to maintain alignment with the plan.

Financial Accountability & Scope Management

  • Anticipates and manages budget risks, with guidance from more senior resources.
  • Manages change orders with clients and ensures alignment with internal stakeholders.
  • Maintains and proactively communicates accurate and up-to-date scope and budget status.

Responsive Self Starter

  • Responds promptly to internal and external communications.
  • Maintains consistent communication and follows through on open items.
  • Completes tasks independently and seeks clarification when needed.
  • Demonstrates accountability and looks for opportunities to take initiative within scope.

Requirements

  • 2 years of college or equivalent work experience.
  • Excellent communication skills; participates confidently in internal and client conversations. And any relevant upselling experience would be a great asset.
  • Self-starter who works well independently but is also a team player.
  • Exposure to project planning or coordination through internships, academic coursework, or junior roles is expected. Familiarity with task tracking and timelines is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated track record of successfully handling difficult situations and resolving conflicts.
  • Exposure to tracking hours, budgets, or estimates is preferred. Strong plus for experience logging time or reviewing/managing scope changes / change orders.
  • Experience maintaining simple project trackers or task logs required. Demonstrated experience with PM tools like Asana or Smartsheet is preferred.
  • Demonstrated track record of managing high-pressure situations effectively. History of balancing multiple tasks while maintaining strong relationships. Demonstrates proactive communication and collaboration, fostering a positive, solutions-oriented work environment.

Compensation

Base $51,000–82,000 CAD depending on experience, plus a discretionary performance-based bonus paid semi-annually. Full inecta benefits package including RRSP with 3% company contribution, sunlife insurance, LTD, STD, vacation, sick time. 100% remote. Occasional travel may be required.

inecta Food is a cloud ERP platform purpose-built for the food and beverage industry — designed from the ground up for the way food companies actually operate. For over 20 years, we’ve partnered with processors, manufacturers, distributors, growers, and retailers across North America and around the globe.

We’re a ~80-person company with staff across Canada, the US, and India. We’re fast paced, cutting edge, highly technical, deeply knowledgeable. We value teamwork, energy, ownership, bias to action, and genuinely caring about our clients.

inecta is an equal opportunity employer.

raw.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Cette fonction s’inscrit dans un environnement comprenant environ 800 applications, dont près de 400 applications web, basées sur des technologies et des prestataires variés. Une maîtrise insuffisante de leur cycle de vie peut entraîner des interruptions de services, des compromissions de données ou de fonctionnalités, l’exploitation de vulnérabilités dans le code, les composants ou les configurations, ainsi qu’une augmentation de la dette technique, des risques d’obsolescence et des écarts de conformité.

Dans ce contexte, vous contribuez à une équipe dédiée au Secure Application Lifecycle Management (SALM), avec pour objectif de renforcer et d’automatiser la sécurité applicative sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie logiciel.

  • Déterminer la criticité des applications et les contrôles de sécurité à appliquer.
  • Réaliser les analyses de risques et assurer le suivi des mesures décidées selon la méthodologie en place.
  • Définir et faire évoluer les standards et bonnes pratiques de sécurité applicative.
  • Intégrer les contrôles de sécurité dans les projets et dans les chaînes DevSecOps/CI/CD.
  • Mettre en œuvre et exploiter des outils de sécurité applicative tels que SAST, DAST, SCA, la détection de secrets, les scans de vulnérabilités et les tests d’intrusion.
  • Analyser et qualifier les vulnérabilités en évaluant leur exploitabilité, leur impact, les faux positifs et leur niveau de priorité.
  • Suivre les dérogations, les risques résiduels et les recommandations avant la mise en production.
  • Assurer le suivi des vulnérabilités, de l’obsolescence et du décommissionnement des applications.
  • Accompagner les équipes de développement sur la sécurisation du code, des API, des dépendances logicielles, des conteneurs et de la gestion des secrets.
  • Produire une restitution technique claire, ainsi qu’une documentation structurée à destination des parties prenantes.

Vous collaborez étroitement avec les chefs de projet, développeurs, architectes, équipes d’exploitation, responsables fonctionnels, centres de services, équipes DevSecOps et SecOps, SOC, métiers et prestataires.

L’enjeu est de faire évoluer des contrôles encore ponctuels ou manuels vers une approche commune, proportionnée aux risques, davantage automatisée et couvrant l’ensemble du cycle de vie des applications.

📝 Votre profil

Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en tant qu’IT Security Analyst.

Compétences essentielles :

  • Analyse et qualification des vulnérabilités : exploitabilité, impact, faux positifs et priorisation.
  • Architecture et sécurité applicative : flux, authentification, autorisation, chiffrement, API et dépendances.
  • Chaînes CI/CD et pratiques DevSecOps : intégration, paramétrage, automatisation et quality gates.
  • Outils de sécurité applicative : SAST, DAST, SCA, détection de secrets et scans de vulnérabilités.
  • Connaissance des référentiels techniques : OWASP Top 10, ASVS, SAMM, CWE, CVSS et NIST SSDF.
  • Capacité de restitution technique, de documentation et d’accompagnement des équipes de développement.
  • Bonne compréhension de la sécurité du développement, des API, des dépendances logicielles, des conteneurs et de la gestion des secrets.

Langue requise : français.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

(Freelance est également possible)

raw.description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart’s Developer Platform team enables engineers to build, test, and validate software quickly, consistently, and with confidence. We own foundational systems and workflows engineers rely on before software reaches production, including build and continuous integration infrastructure, ephemeral environments, shared test infrastructure, and developer tooling.

Our goal is to make the path from code change to deployable software fast, reliable, and self-service. We build platforms that provide trusted feedback early, enable engineers to validate changes in production-like environments, and make common development and testing capabilities easy to adopt across engineering. We partner closely with Delivery, Cloud Platform, Site Reliability Engineering, Security, and product engineering teams to create a cohesive developer experience.

As a Software Engineer II, Developer Platform at Upstart, you will build and operate systems used by engineers across Upstart to develop, test, and prepare software for production. You’ll work across continuous integration infrastructure, Kubernetes-based ephemeral environments, test infrastructure, and developer tooling while independently delivering well-scoped engineering projects and contributing to technical design.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Build and improve services, infrastructure, and developer tooling that power continuous integration, ephemeral environments, and automated testing across Upstart
  • Develop scalable Kubernetes- and AWS-based capabilities that enable engineers to create and use production-like environments through reliable, self-service workflows
  • Build shared infrastructure for test execution, orchestration, environment setup, and results to provide engineers with fast, trustworthy feedback during development and continuous integration
  • Improve platform reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency by diagnosing recurring issues and implementing durable software and infrastructure improvements
  • Replace manual or fragmented developer workflows with reusable APIs, automation, and platform capabilities that simplify common development tasks
  • Use AI throughout software development and problem solving, and identify opportunities for AI-enabled workflows and capabilities that improve developer productivity across Upstart

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field (or its equivalent), plus 3 years of professional software engineering experience
  • Experience developing production software using one or more general-purpose programming languages
  • Experience designing, building, testing, and operating production software or infrastructure
  • Experience working with cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, continuous integration systems, developer tooling, or backend services
  • Experience independently delivering well-scoped software engineering projects from technical design through production operation
  • Demonstrated experience using AI assisted development tools across multiple stages of the software engineering lifecycle, with an interest in continuously evolving how you use these tools as their capabilities advance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Kubernetes control-plane engineering, AWS, containers, or infrastructure as code
  • Knowledge of developer tooling, continuous integration systems, internal developer platforms, or shared test infrastructure
  • Experience building or operating ephemeral or production-like development and testing environments
  • Experience building APIs, services, command-line tools, test orchestration, or automation used by other engineers
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools across the software engineering lifecycle or building AI-enabled developer workflows and automation

Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range
$142,000—$196,600 USD

What you'll love

At Upstart, our benefits are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly
  • Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)
  • Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada.
  • Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)
  • Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security
  • Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements
  • Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country)
  • Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources
  • Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only)
  • Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you
  • Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from
  • Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs)
  • Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City

For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec.

Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices.

We're scaling our audio annotation operations and need an experienced team manager to oversee daily operations, quality control, and training for our growing freelancer workforce. You'll be the operational backbone ensuring our transcription projects deliver consistent, high-quality results while hitting ambitious volume targets.

What You'll Own Daily

Team Leadership & Management

  • Manage 20-40 remote freelance annotators across multiple concurrent audio transcription projects

  • Monitor individual and team performance across Data Plus, Label Studio, and SuperAnnotate platforms

  • Handle escalations, resolve workflow bottlenecks, and maintain team morale

  • Coordinate assignment distribution and workload balancing across annotators

Training Program Development

  • Design and deliver comprehensive onboarding programs for new annotators

  • Create training materials for Data Plus, Label Studio, and SuperAnnotate platform usage and transcription guidelines

  • Conduct regular calibration sessions to maintain quality standards

  • Develop skill-building workshops for complex annotation scenarios

Quality Assurance Operations

  • Manage QA team members who review annotator submissions

  • Establish and maintain quality control processes and sampling strategies

  • Analyze quality metrics and implement improvement initiatives

  • Handle quality escalations and corrective action plans

Platform Operations & Assignment Management

  • Monitor daily progress and assignment completion across Data Plus, Label Studio, and SuperAnnotate

  • Manage task distribution and deadline tracking across all platforms and active projects

  • Troubleshoot platform-specific issues and coordinate with technical support teams

  • Optimize workflow processes across platforms to maximize efficiency and output

Performance Reporting & Analytics

  • Generate weekly KPI reports covering hours annotated, quality percentages, and productivity metrics

  • Track team performance against targets and identify improvement opportunities

  • Present operational updates and recommendations to senior management

  • Maintain detailed records of team performance and project outcomes

Ready to lead the team building tomorrow's AI speech capabilities?

This is a remote contract position requiring immediate availability.

Requirements

What You Bring to the Role

Essential Leadership Experience

2+ years managing annotation or transcription teams (minimum requirement)

Proven track record leading remote freelancer workforces (15+ people)

Experience with quality control processes in linguistic or content annotation projects

Success meeting aggressive volume and quality targets with distributed teams

Annotation Industry Knowledge

Deep understanding of audio transcription workflows and quality standards

Experience with multiple annotation platforms (Data Plus, Label Studio, SuperAnnotate, or similar), workflow management, and QA processes

Knowledge of linguistic annotation challenges (stutters, overlaps, accents, etc.)

Familiarity with speech dataset requirements for AI training

Operational Excellence

Strong project management skills with ability to juggle multiple concurrent projects

Experience developing training programs and documentation for technical processes

Data-driven approach to performance management and process optimization

Excellent problem-solving skills for workflow bottlenecks and quality issues

Communication & Leadership

Outstanding written English with ability to create clear training materials

Experience providing feedback and coaching to improve individual performance

Comfortable presenting metrics and recommendations to senior management

Strong interpersonal skills for managing remote, multicultural teams

Technical Readiness

Comfortable learning and managing multiple annotation platforms and workflow tools

Experience with cross-platform performance tracking, reporting, and basic data analysis

Reliable home office setup for managing distributed teams

Available during core business hours with flexibility for global team coordination

Highlights

Lead 20-40 remote annotators building AI speech datasets! Manage multi-platform operations, training & QA. 2+ years annotation team leadership required.

raw.excerpt: About Eve Eve is redefining legal technology for plaintiff law firms, and we're building the team that will take us there.
raw.description:
About Eve
Eve is redefining legal technology for plaintiff law firms, and we're building the team that will take us there. We help firms handle more cases, recover more for clients, and grow with AI that works across every stage of a case, from intake through resolution. The next generation of great plaintiff firms will be AI-Native, and Eve is how they get there. But what makes Eve different isn't just the product. It's how we build it. If you're someone who takes ownership, stays curious, and wants to build AI that's already changing how law is practiced, this is where you belong.

Product-market fit: Eve is trusted by over 1000+ law firms, and we’re growing fast.
Backed by top investors: We’ve raised over $160M from world-class partners including Spark Capital, Andreessen Horowitz(A16z), Menlo Ventures, and Lightspeed.
Built by a world-class team: Engineers, designers, and operators from places like Scale, Meta, Airbnb, Cruise, Square, Rubrik, and Lyft are building Eve from the ground up.
AI-Native from day one: We’re on the bleeding edge of AI, collaborating directly with teams at OpenAI and Anthropic to build best-in-class AI workflows tailored for legal work.
Explosive growth: We are growing 2X revenue Quarter over Quarter.

The Role

Eve is doubling revenue quarter over quarter, and the platform is being built to keep pace. A medallion architecture is in place on a Terraform-managed Snowflake footprint. Most of what goes on top is still ahead: ingestion and orchestration built for the volume coming, reliability practice, the access and governance model, and the standards every contributor works inside.

The data spans product usage, case and firm data, and every go-to-market system Eve runs on. Analytics engineers and business analysts build models and reporting on top of it, AI agents query it directly, and leadership makes calls on it weekly. When a pipeline fails quietly, all three inherit the mistake.

You'll own the pipelines carrying all of that, end to end, from an ambiguous ask through to production. Moving nightly rebuilds onto incremental patterns. Deciding how a new source gets ingested and what happens when it changes shape. Building the alerting that catches a broken model before anyone downstream does, and being the one who picks it up when it breaks.

You'll have real say in how the platform gets built. You'll work on our central team and report to the Head of Data Engineering, who reports directly to the CEO. Data is a first-class function at Eve and the fuel to drive our future growth.

What You'll Do

Build and run the platform

  • Own ingestion through Fivetran, third-party connectors, and custom extraction where no connector exists
  • Own orchestration across dbt platform and GitHub Actions, own materialization strategy and model performance, move critical models off nightly full rebuilds onto incremental patterns, and cut latency where decisions are waiting on stale data
  • Build source-schema change detection, so an upstream field change surfaces as an alert before it reaches a report
  • Stand up observability: freshness SLAs on critical tables, alerting on failure and drift, and an incident path with clear ownership
  • Be a first responder when pipelines break, and drive the fix upstream so the same failure doesn't recur
  • Manage pipeline compute cost, and make the tradeoffs between freshness and spend explicit rather than accidental
  • Share Snowflake administration: implementing the role-based access model, security and network policies, data masking and PII controls, and storage organization
  • Extend the medallion architecture and the Terraform-managed footprint, including full separation of development and production
  • Contribute to the foundational modeling layer the Analytics Engineers build on: source-to-staging patterns, conformed dimensions, shared entities, and SCD patterns that make history reliable

Raise the bar

  • Build and maintain the development environments and CI that let analysts contribute models safely, and review their contributions so more of the company can build on the foundation
  • Build the tooling and setup that gets a new engineer or analyst productive in days, not weeks
  • Administer the data tooling stack: access, integrations, and the connective work between systems
  • Use AI-assisted development as part of how you work: Claude Code skills, agents, and evals, held to the same review bar as anything else
  • Document as you build. If it isn't written down, it isn't done

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in data engineering, owning production systems other people depended on
  • Strong Python and SQL, with production experience across ingestion (Fivetran or similar), orchestration (dbt platform, GitHub Actions, or Airflow), and cloud infrastructure
  • Solid Snowflake: access control, warehouse sizing, query performance, and cost management
  • Practical dbt: incremental models, testing, macros, and a git-based workflow with CI. Experience building SCD tables from multiple sources
  • Comfort in a Terraform-managed environment. Infrastructure changes go through code review here, not the Snowflake console
  • You've built reliability practice where none existed: alerting, freshness SLAs, incident response, schema change detection
  • Proficiency with AI-assisted development such as Claude Code, including agentic pipeline design and skill-based workflows, and comfort integrating tools via MCP servers
  • Able to tell a stakeholder what broke, what it affected, and when it'll be fixed, without the jargon
  • Comfort building where the playbook doesn't exist yet

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in a regulated or high-sensitivity data environment (legal, healthcare, financial services)
  • Experience with streaming or near-real-time ingestion, and knowing when it isn't worth it
  • Exposure to Iceberg, Parquet, or unstructured data at scale
  • B2B SaaS, especially selling to small and mid-sized businesses or professional services firms
For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Eve and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.

$185,000—$210,000 USD

Benefits

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with Employer Matching

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🏠 Telecomm Stipend
🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays
🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings
🥪 In office Perks*

*In office employees only

Eve Legal is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. raw.description:
About Us

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.
Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at .

Role Summary

Sophos is seeking a highly skilled Senior Incident Response Analyst to support Managed Detection and Response (MDR) customers within the Critical Incident Response Team (CIRT).

As a Senior Incident Response Analyst 2, you will lead complex and high-impact incident response engagements, operating across Responder, Advisor, and Commander roles as required. You are trusted to provide advanced technical leadership, shape investigative strategy, guide containment decisions, and ensure high-quality customer outcomes during critical security incidents.

What You Will Do

  • Lead complex investigations involving advanced adversaries, multi-vector intrusions, or cross-environment compromise
  • Serve as the primary Incident Advisor or delegated Commander for high-severity engagements
  • Direct and coordinate investigative, forensic, and containment activities across multiple analysts
  • Define engagement strategy, investigative priorities, and containment approaches based on risk and impact
  • Validate and synthesize technical findings into clear, actionable guidance for customers and internal stakeholders
  • Provide technical mentorship and oversight to IR and SOC analysts
  • Collaborate closely with SOC, Threat Intelligence, and Detection Engineering teams to validate detections and close visibility gaps
  • Lead or contribute to post-incident reviews, driving improvements to playbooks, tools, and response workflows
  • Maintain accurate time and activity tracking to support operational visibility and capacity planning

What You Will Bring

    Essential:

  • 5+ years of experience in incident response, MDR, or cyber security investigations, including leadership of complex incidents
  • Advanced expertise in endpoint and network forensics, log analysis, and adversary tradecraft
  • Strong understanding of enterprise network architecture and IT infrastructure
  • Proven ability to lead investigations, validate findings, and design effective containment strategies
  • Experience communicating technical findings to customers, including senior and executive stakeholders
  • Demonstrated mentorship and leadership across incident response teams
  • Ability to operate effectively under high-pressure, time-sensitive conditions
  • Willingness to work some weekends and holidays as part of a rotation

    • Desired:

  • Advanced incident response or forensic certifications (GCFA, GCED, GCIH, OSCP, or equivalent)
  • Experience acting as Incident Advisor or Commander during critical engagements
  • Publications, presentations, or recognized contributions within the cybersecurity field
  • Experience influencing detection strategy, tooling improvements, or service design
  • Strong customer-facing presence with experience briefing executives during incidents
In Canada, the base salary for this role ranges from $131,000 to $219,000. In addition to base salary, we offer additional compensation including bonus eligibility and a comprehensive benefits package.  A candidate’s specific pay within this range will depend on a variety of factors, including job-related skills, training, location, experience, relevant education, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. ​

At Sophos, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives to fuel innovation. Research shows that candidates sometimes hesitate to apply if they don't check every box in a job description. We challenge that notion. Your unique experiences and skills might be exactly what we need to enhance our team. Don't let a checklist hold you back – we encourage you to apply.

What's Great About Sophos?

· Sophos operates a remote-first working model, making remote work the primary option for most employees. However, some roles may necessitate a hybrid approach. While we are a remote first organization, applicants must have legal authorization to work in the jurisdiction where the position is posted, without requiring employer sponsorship.

· Global employee sustainability initiatives to reduce our environmental footprint
· Global fitness and trivia competitions to keep our bodies and minds sharp

Our Commitment To You

We’re proud of the diverse and inclusive environment we have at Sophos, and we’re committed to ensuring equality of opportunity. We believe that diversity, combined with excellence, builds a better Sophos, so we encourage applicants who can contribute to the diversity of our team. We want to give you every opportunity to show us your best self, so if there are any adjustments we could make to the recruitment and selection process to support you, please let us know.

Data Protection
