raw.title: Director, Long Haul OSP Deployment (East)
raw.excerpt: Company DescriptionZayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society.
raw.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Director, Long Haul OSP Deployment (East)

Our Director, Long Haul OSP Deployment (East)is responsible forleading theend to enddelivery of long haul OSP deployment programs in the western U.S., with a primary focus on managing 1–2 turnkey engineering and construction contractors across 5–8 simultaneous projects. These builds willbe primarilygreenfield, with occasional overpull components.

Our Director ensures that each contractorexecutes tothe defined scope, schedule, budget, and quality standards by applying disciplined project management, rigorous contract oversight, and proactive risk mitigation. This rolemaintainsstrong communicationwith internal stakeholders, contractor leadership,permittingauthorities, and customers. Our Director reports to the Head of Long Haul OSP Deployment.

NOTE: The team is open to this position working remotely within the United States - East Coast.

Key Responsibilities

Program & Contractor Management

  • Lead the overall delivery of 5–8 long haul OSP projects executed by 1–2 large turnkey contractors.

  • Serve as the primary operational and contractual interface with turnkey partners, ensuring compliance with all terms, milestones, deliverables, and performance metrics.

  • Conduct regular contractor performance reviews focused on schedule adherence, budget performance, production rates, safety, and quality.

  • Drive accountability through structured reporting, issue escalation, and corrective action planning when contractor output deviates from expectations.

Project Planning & Execution

  • Validate each project’s greenfield route scope, fiber counts, structure type, and constructability to ensure clear alignment between requirements and contracted deliverables.

  • Oversee route feasibility and risk analysis to accurately forecast project cost, schedule, andrequiredresources before construction begins.

  • Manage andmaintainproject-level schedules and budgets, ensuring turnkey partners update and track progress accurately and transparently.

  • Ensuretimelysubmittal and approval of engineering packages,permittingapplications, traffic control plans, and environmental/regulatory filings.

Contract Governance & Compliance

  • Own the contract execution strategy, from contract kickoff through construction closeout.

  • Monitor contractor compliance with unit pricing, milestone requirements, SLAs, and change-order procedures.

  • Validate quantities, production reports, invoicing accuracy, and adherence to the agreed-upon schedule of values.

  • Ensure change orders are justified, properly documented, and aligned with contractual terms before approval.

Material & Construction Oversight

  • Overseecontractormaterial forecasting, ordering, receiving, and field distribution to ensure alignment with project timelines.

  • Monitor field production rates and collaborate with project managers and contractors to implement recovery plans if deviations occur.

Reporting & Stakeholder Communication

  • Deliveraccurate, concise project reporting at both the program and executive levels, including progress summaries, risk assessments, and mitigation strategies.

  • Providetimelyupdates to customer teams and internal partners throughout construction.

  • Deliver complete andaccurateasbuiltpackages to GIS, network operations, and inventory teams.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of project managers, fostering strong execution discipline and a culture of accountability.

  • Promote continuous improvement in vendor management, project controls, andlong hauldelivery practices.

  • Support cross-functional collaboration with regional OSP teams to ensure program alignment with local initiatives and broader network strategy.

Education, Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Telecommunications, or a related technical field; equivalent work experience considered.

  • Business, finance, or project management coursework or degree a plus.

  • Minimum of ten (10) years of successful people leadership experience in largescale network deployment or construction environments.

  • Minimum of ten (10) years managing complex, multiphase telecommunications projects, ideally involving OSP,longhaulfiber, Ethernet, or wireless networks.

  • Minimum of ten (10) years of OSP construction management experience withdemonstratedexpertiseinlonghaulbuilds, greenfield construction, and contractor oversight.

  • Extensive experience managing turnkey (EPC) contractors, including tracking deliverables, enforcing contract terms, and driving performance.

  • Proven history of delivering large,multimilliondollarfiber deployment programs on schedule and within budget.

  • Experience administering NTIA or similar federal program requirements (e.g.,DavisBacon, BABA, environmental assessments).

  • Specific experience navigating complex permitting and regulatory processes such as NEPA, Section 106, Tribal engagement, and ROW negotiations.

  • Strong understanding of OSP construction standards, fiber cable specifications, andlonghauldesign principles.

  • Working knowledge of optical network concepts, fiber testing standards, and acceptance criteria.

  • Ability to read, understand, andvalidatefiber testing output; experience with tools such as EXFOFastReportera plus.

  • Familiarity withGISbasedtools (e.g., ArcGIS/ArcView, MapInfo, Google Earth).

  • Knowledge of the U.S. carrier,longhaul, anddarkfibermarket landscape.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and contractors in afastpaced,highvisibilityenvironment.

  • Strong financial acumen, including budget creation, cost control,unitpricevalidation, and invoice verification.

  • Experience developing, negotiating, and administering largescale construction and engineering contracts.

  • Skilled in risk identification, mitigation planning, and escalating issues to resolution.

  • Proficiencywith MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace tools.

  • Experience with project management platforms such asSitetrackerstronglypreferred.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRMtoolsa plus.

  • Exceptionalproblem solvingandcritical thinkingcapabilities.

  • Strong communicationskills withanability to convey complex technical issues to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated leadership qualities with the ability to mentor teams, build consensus, and drive high contractor accountability.

  • High levelof organization, urgency, and attention to detail.

  • Ability to travel up to ~10% for key field visits, vendor oversight,permitmeetings, and escalations.

  • Mustbe authorized towork in the United States.

Estimated base salary range: $117,000 - $180,000 USD/annually.

#

The base pay range shown is a guideline and reasonable estimate for this role. It takes into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions. Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted range based upon geographic location, work experience, skill level, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. Non- sales roles may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive plan. Sales roles may be eligible to participate in a sales incentive plan.

Additionally, this position may be eligible for certain benefits, such as health insurance, life insurance, disability retirement plans, paid time off.

The posting will be active for a minimum of 3 days. The active posting will continue to extend by 3 days until the position is filled.

Benefits, Rewards & Wellness

  • Excellent Health, Dental & Vision Insurance

  • Retirement 401(k) Savings Plan

  • Generous paid time off policy including paid parental leave

Zayo provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, provincial or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

raw.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Engineer to support our multi-regional cloud infrastructure on AWS. This role will focus on ensuring operational excellence by addressing P1-P5 issues in alignment with SLA requirements, implementing cost improvement initiatives, and exploring opportunities for tool unification. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with AWS services deployed at an enterprise scale and will collaborate with a distributed team of developers across various time zones.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Respond to and resolve P1-P5 issues in accordance with SLA requirements.
  • Implement and recommend cost improvement strategies and ideas.
  • Collaborate on tool unification efforts to streamline operations.
  • Monitor and maintain cloud infrastructure using Datadog to ensure performance and reliability.
  • Support and manage various AWS services, including but not limited to: DynamoDB, Kinesis, Lambda, ECS, EKS, KMS, ALB
  • Participate in a 24x5 support scheme, including on-call duties on weekends every 3-4 months.
  • Work effectively with cross-functional teams distributed across different time zones.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years in cloud engineering or related roles.

Technical Skills:

  • Proficient in AWS services, particularly in a multi-region deployment at enterprise scale.
  • Experience with Datadog or similar monitoring tools.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud architecture and best practices.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills to work collaboratively with remote teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) are a plus but not mandatory.
  • Work with professionals who have created some of the most revolutionary solutions in their fields.
  • Make an impact. Work in large-scale projects globally.
  • Develop your career in our Studios. Each Studio represents deep pockets of expertise on the latest technologies and trends and delivers tailored solutions focused on specific challenges.
  • Develop your career within an industry or multiple industries.
  • Work in the city you want, and be nourished by cultural exchanges.
  • Be empowered to choose your career path: we have more than 600 simultaneous projects, so you can choose where and how to work.

The Director, Commercial is a senior, US-based leadership role responsible for driving business performance across commercial terms, pricing, profitability, and service delivery efficiency. This role serves as a strategic partner to practice leaders, finance, and technology teams, translating global commercial strategy into measurable results.

The Director will own advanced pricing and profitability analytics, support revenue growth initiatives, and help promote Fragomen products portfolio. This role balances strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Strategy & Execution

  • Design and execute commercial strategies to improve revenue growth, profitability, and pricing discipline across practices and growth platforms.
  • Adapt global commercial frameworks, tools, and pricing models to meet regional and market-specific needs, with a focus on the US market.
  • Support third-party vendor (TPV) and Member Network Firms initiatives in collaboration with procurement.
  • Oversee strategic accounts / practices reviews to drive continuous path to improved profitability
  • Support strategic client and channel engagements including complex client negotiations

Pricing, Profitability & Analytics

  • Develop and maintain firmwide pricing analyses, billing insights, and service line profitability models.
  • Track, analyze, and report on RFPs, pitches, and pricing events; generate insights to improve win rates and margin outcomes.
  • Own profitability tracking before and after pricing interventions, partnering closely with Finance and Practice Leadership.
  • Maintain and enhance global pricing templates, scopes of service, and non-standard pricing structures.
  • Support P&L monitoring at the practice and region levels, ensuring alignment with performance targets.
  • Provide actionable insights to partners and senior leaders to drive sustained profitability.

Market Intelligence & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Conduct competitive intelligence analyses and market reviews to inform pricing, product, and growth strategies.
  • Act as a trusted commercial advisor to partners, practice leaders, and senior stakeholders across regions.
  • Lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

Cost-to-Serve Analysis & Operational Efficiency

  • Analyze cost-to-serve across practices and regions to identify margin drivers, inefficiencies, and scalability opportunities.
  • Develop and propose data-backed efficiency initiatives, including process improvements, scope, and delivery model enhancements.
  • Share best practices and performance insights across practices to promote consistency, operational discipline, and sustainable profitability.

People Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and develop a small team of pricing and commercial professionals.
  • Set clear priorities, provide coaching and mentorship, and ensure the team delivers timely, high-quality commercial insights and support to stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Law, or related field; MBA or JD/LLB preferred.
  • 10–15 years of progressive experience in commercial strategy, pricing, business development, consulting, procurement, or product-led growth roles within a global organization.
  • Demonstrated experience with pricing strategy, profitability analysis, and P&L management across multiple markets or service lines.
  • Strong negotiation and stakeholder influence skills.
  • Proficiency in Excel and business intelligence tools; comfort turning messy data into decisions.
  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives in fast-paced, matrixed environments.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to operate credibly at partner and executive levels.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.

The solution architect proactively and holistically leads and supports enterprise architecture (EA) activities that guide the development and management of a portfolio of solutions. Solutions include projects and products, systems (including applications, technologies, processes and information), shared infrastructure services and shared application services. They understand the concepts of business goals, objectives and business outcomes, business capabilities, value-streams and business processes and their importance in solution architecture. The solutions architect provides the necessary leadership, analysis and design tasks related to support the development of technology solutions to ensure that solutions meet business needs and align with architectural governance and standards. They create deliverables for managing the organization's portfolio of "to be" and "as is" solutions — including systems (applications, processes, information and technology), shared infrastructure services, and shared application services and components to enable and drive targeted business outcomes.

Responsibilities and Qualifications

Interpret Business Needs

  • Translates business and technical needs into an architectural plan, documenting all solution design work and analysis.
  • Collaborates with product owners to understand business drivers, current capabilities, future requirements, creating enterprise solution design and change requirements.

Assess Technology

  • Evaluate and recommend new technologies, tools, and platforms to support business goals
  • Analyzes the business-IT environment to detect critical deficiencies, legacy and technical debt, and recommends solutions for improvement
  • Supports product managers in end-of-life product decisions to maintain, refresh or retire services or systems, including applications, technologies, processes and information

Apply Technology

  • Leads the evaluation, design, and analysis for the implementation of solutions architecture across specific business applications or technologies based on enterprise business strategy, business capabilities, value-streams, business requirements, enterprise standards and regulatory requirements such as HIPAA.
  • Creates architectural designs and artifacts to guide and contextualize solution development across products, services, projects, and systems, including solution blueprints, data flow diagrams, and integration patterns. Collaborates with other architects as necessary for alignment across projects, products, or initiatives.
  • Defines the principles, guidelines, standards, and solution patterns to ensure solution decisions are aligned with the enterprise's future-state architecture vision.
  • Coordinates with development teams to identify needs and maintains a roadmap of required design changes due to changes in the enterprise technology landscape.
  • Provides consulting support and subject matter expertise to developers within agile teams by providing advice and guidance on opportunities, impact and risks, taking account of technical, architectural debt and overall enterprise architecture standards.

Job Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience in IT, with at least 4 years in a solution architecture role developing architecture blueprints, strategies and roadmaps
  • Experience designing, implementing, and integrating high-performance, scalable, reusable, enterprise applications leveraging Websphere Open Liberty, Springboot, HCL Portal, database technologies like Oracle, SQL Server, and API technologies
  • Knowledge of various development languages and frameworks like Java, C# and Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, JSF, and Angular
  • Proficiency in designing, implementing integration architecture like event driven architecture leveraging SOAP web services, RESTful API, HL7 FHIR standards and technologies like Apache Kafka.
  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce and associated technology stack.
  • Understanding of at least one of the cloud computing platforms like AWS, Azure (preferred), or Google Cloud
  • Experience architecting and implementing secure CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, Maven etc. for continuous integration and delivery
  • Strong domain knowledge of healthcare payer operations including claims, eligibility, benefits, provider networks, and care management.

Skills:

  • Proven analytical, planning, organizational and technical skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Skilled at influencing, guiding and facilitating stakeholders and peers with decision making
  • Ability to articulate new ideas and concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences
  • Skilled at understanding the long-term

What You’ll need

Preferred Qualifications

Client Services Specialist

Location: Remote, USA

Department: Customer Success

About Syllo

Syllo is defining the Litigation AI category. We are the first unified platform designed to autonomously manage the entire litigation lifecycle end-to-end. Founded in 2019 by a team of litigators and engineers, Syllo enables legal teams to securely harness the power of AI across any matter, regardless of complexity or scale. Our technology supports Fortune 500 companies and AmLaw 200 firms managing their most complex litigation portfolios. Awarded ILTA Transformative Project of the Year and ALM eDiscovery Technology of the Year for 2026, we are the market leader in enterprise-grade litigation AI. Backed by top-tier VCs, we are at a clear inflection point — the team has doubled in the last six months and growth is accelerating.

About the role

Be the expert at the intersection of litigation workflow and AI.

This role sits on the front line of client delivery, supporting AmLaw 200 firms and Fortune 500 legal teams as they run their most complex cases on Syllo's platform. You will serve as the named CS account owner for an assigned portfolio of clients, managing case delivery end-to-end and working in close partnership with the Sales Account Director as a key member of the account team. We are looking for someone who knows the litigation lifecycle from the inside, owns their work without being told to, and remains composed when timelines compress and priorities shift. Prior experience as a paralegal, attorney, or litigation support professional is required.

What you will do

  • Own your accounts: Serve as the named CS account owner for an assigned portfolio of clients, building trusted relationships and escalating proactively to CS leadership when clients are at risk.
  • Partner with Sales: Work in close partnership with the Sales Account Director, maintaining a shared view of account status and consistent communication across the account team.
  • Manage case delivery: Own end-to-end project management for active cases, including kickoffs, timelines, deliverables, client-facing status updates, and setting clear expectations on client-side dependencies.
  • Execute client services work: Handle client services requests including building searches, workspace organization, and executing AI-assisted reviews.
  • Advise attorneys on workflow: Translate platform capabilities into case strategy. When an attorney asks what is possible, you have an answer.
  • Coordinate across teams: Work with the Data Services team on data needs, ensuring requirements are documented accurately before work begins.
  • Triage and resolve issues: Identify and help resolve technical or workflow issues as they arise, escalating through the appropriate process when needed.
  • Build for continuity: Document case status, known issues, and handoff notes so work survives transitions. When handing off to another pod member, maintain active oversight to protect delivery quality and the client relationship.
  • Become a product expert: Develop deep expertise in the Syllo platform, capture and relay product feedback to the product team, and participate in product testing.
  • Contribute to the team: Collaborate on internal CS documentation, process resources, and thought leadership on the use of AI in litigation.

What you bring

  • Litigation lifecycle knowledge: You understand case assessment, document review, production, and privilege workflows from firsthand experience.
  • Project ownership: You have run end-to-end delivery on a case, not just contributed to a team output.
  • Client-facing composure: You communicate clearly with attorneys and partners under pressure, in writing and in person.

Total rewards and benefits

Equal opportunity employer

title: Chief Executive Assistant

raw.title: Chief Executive Assistant
raw.excerpt: About Squared AwaySquared Away supports founders, executives, and leadership teams moving fast, carrying a lot, and expecting excellence.
raw.description:
About Squared Away

Squared Away supports founders, executives, and leadership teams moving fast, carrying a lot, and expecting excellence.

Our Assistants are not task-takers waiting for instructions. They are strategic operators, problem-solvers, and trusted partners who create order in the chaos, anticipate what’s coming next, protect priorities, and make sure nothing important gets dropped.

We exist to give exceptional leaders back their most valuable resource: time.

That requires more than checking boxes. It requires judgment, discretion, ownership, extreme attention to detail, and the ability to execute consistently in environments where the pace is high and the expectations are higher.

If you need someone to tell you exactly what to do next, this probably isn’t the role for you.

If you are the person who notices the problem before anyone else does, figures it out, communicates clearly, and gets it across the finish line, we want to know you.

Squared Away maintains a rolling application for our Executive Assistant position. This application is for opportunities anticipated during Q4 2026, (October through December).

A Note About Our 2027 Transition

Squared Away is transitioning its Chief Executive Assistant team to W-2 employment beginning January 1, 2027.

Candidates who join Squared Away during Q4 will initially onboard as 1099 independent contractors for the remainder of 2026. Effective January 1, 2027, they will transition to W-2 employment with Squared Away, along with the rest of our Chief Executive Assistant team.

Compensation, availability expectations, and other employment terms change with the transition to W-2 employment. Both the Q4 contractor terms and 2027 W-2 terms are outlined below so candidates can understand the full opportunity before applying.

We are looking for candidates who are interested in building a longer-term career with Squared Away and are prepared to transition to the W-2 position in January.

What We're Looking For

This is not an entry-level role, and it is absolutely not a side gig.

As a Chief Executive Assistant at Squared Away, you will work alongside senior executives who move quickly, manage significant responsibility, and expect the person beside them to think ahead, communicate clearly, and execute without needing constant direction.

You will manage competing priorities, anticipate needs before they become urgent, protect your executive’s time, and take ownership of outcomes at a level that mirrors exceptional in-house executive support.

We are looking for experienced professionals who know how to operate in ambiguity, solve problems without waiting to be rescued, exercise strong judgment, and build trusted relationships with high-performing leaders.

You should be comfortable making decisions, asking smart questions, following through relentlessly, and owning your work from start to finish.

This role is for someone who does not just want to support an executive. It is for someone who wants to become indispensable to one.

What Tends to Work Well in This Role

Our work is fast-paced, collaborative, and built on trust. Assistants who thrive here typically:

  • Have established experience supporting senior executives
  • Enjoy variety and problem-solving over repetitive task work
  • Are available and responsive during weekday business hours
  • Take a proactive approach and anticipate needs rather than waiting for direction
  • Stay effective when priorities change or when not everything is fully defined
  • Treat confidentiality and discretion as non-negotiable
  • Communicate clearly when priorities, deadlines, or circumstances change
  • Build systems and routines that allow them to manage multiple priorities without sacrificing quality

If you see yourself in this list, you’re likely a great match for how we work at Squared Away.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Executive Operations & Time Management

  • Manage and optimize complex executive calendars across time zones
  • Anticipate conflicts and proactively resolve scheduling issues
  • Protect executive focus by enforcing priorities and boundaries

Executive Communication

  • Manage executive inboxes with discretion and sound judgment
  • Draft, respond to, and triage correspondence on behalf of executives
  • Ensure urgent matters are surfaced promptly and appropriately

Travel & Logistics

  • Coordinate domestic and international travel end-to-end
  • Prepare detailed itineraries and anticipate changes or disruptions

Preparation & Execution

  • Prepare meeting materials, agendas, presentations, and reports
  • Track action items, deadlines, and follow-through across initiatives

Systems & Process Improvement

  • Create, document, and refine workflows to improve efficiency
  • Identify tools and processes that reduce friction and increase clarity

Research & Strategic Support

  • Conduct research on competitors, tools, vendors, and market trends
  • Provide concise summaries to support executive decision-making

Discretion & Trust

  • Handle sensitive and confidential information with absolute integrity

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

In the first 90 days, successful Chief Executive Assistants at Squared Away typically:

  • Actively take on client work and build momentum by supporting assigned clients successfully
  • Build trust and rapport with their executive(s) through consistent communication and follow-through
  • Develop a strong understanding of executive priorities, preferences, and working style
  • Take ownership of calendar and inbox management, proactively anticipating needs and resolving issues before escalation
  • Establish reliable systems for tracking tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups
  • Communicate clearly and confidently, even when priorities shift or information is incomplete
  • Maintain discretion and professionalism while handling sensitive information
  • Structure their workday to balance availability, focused work time, and responsiveness

This is not about perfection. It’s about progress, ownership, and building momentum.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications (Required)

  • Applicants must maintain a permanent U.S. address in one of the following states:
    • Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, California*, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Illinois*, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland*, Michigan, Missouri, Nevada, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania*, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington*.
      • Local hiring restrictions apply in the following areas:
        • California: We are not currently hiring individuals whose primary work location is within Berkeley, Emeryville, Los Angeles, Oakland, San Francisco, Santa Monica, or West Hollywood.
        • Illinois: We are not currently hiring individuals whose primary work location is within Chicago or Cook County.
        • Maryland: We are not currently hiring individuals whose primary work location is within Montgomery County.
        • Pennsylvania: We are not currently hiring individuals whose primary work location is within Pittsburgh.
        • Washington: We are not currently hiring individuals whose primary work location is within Seattle.

Military spouses living overseas on active orders are welcome to apply, provided they maintain a permanent address in one of the states listed above and can reliably support clients during U.S. business hours.

  • Must be available during normal business hours Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM (in your time zone) for regular client communication
    • This role cannot be combined with another job that limits availability during these hours
  • Ability to commit a minimum of 50 hours per month, with flexibility to take on additional hours
  • Administrative experience supporting senior leaders is required; experience supporting executive-level roles is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working remotely is strongly preferred
  • Reliable home office setup, including:
    • Mac or PC computer with webcam
    • High-speed internet
    • Smartphone with email capabilities
    • A designated, quiet workspace suitable for professional work

Skills & Attributes We Look For

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to clearly and concisely communicate in a variety of contexts
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, with familiarity using project management tools
  • Experience managing schedules, communication, and priorities across time zones
  • Understanding of cross-cultural communication in a global working environment
  • Exceptional organization and attention to detail
  • High emotional intelligence and situational awareness
  • Comfortable working independently without constant direction
  • Tech-savvy and quick to learn new systems and tools
  • Proactive mindset that anticipates needs rather than reacts

Benefits

Compensation & 2027 Transition

Candidates hired during Q4 will begin as 1099 independent contractors through December 31, 2026 and transition to W-2 employment effective January 1, 2027.

October–December 2026: Independent Contractor

All new Chief Executive Assistants begin at Tier 1: $24/hour.

Beginning January 1, 2027: W-2 Employment

Effective January 1, 2027, the Tier 1 rate is $22/hour.

W-2 hourly rates reflect the shift from independent contractor status to employment, including employer-paid payroll taxes and the benefits provided as part of the W-2 employment package.

How the Role Works

  • Assistants are paid for hours worked.
  • Time is tracked through Harvest Time Tracking, and payments are issued twice monthly.
  • Most assistants support 2–4 clients at a time.
  • Client assignments are based on business needs, availability, experience, and fit.
  • Squared Away handles client acquisition, client contracts, billing, and invoicing so you can focus on providing exceptional executive support.
  • You'll work with a vetted client base across a wide range of industries, including venture capital, consulting, finance, marketing, nonprofit, real estate, technology, and more.
  • This is a fully remote role.

Beginning January 1, 2027, assistants will become W-2 employees and will be eligible for the policies and benefits applicable to the W-2 Chief Executive Assistant position.

Candidates who move forward in the hiring process will receive information about the full 2027 employment package before accepting an offer.

Authentic, not Artificial

We value clear thinking, sound judgment, and authentic communication.

We recognize that AI tools are increasingly part of how people work, and we support thoughtful, responsible use of them.

During the application process, we’re looking to understand how you think and communicate. Responses should reflect your own voice, experience, and decision-making. Submitting answers that are fully generated by AI, without your input or perspective, may impact your candidacy.

If you move forward, it’s because we see how you approach problems, communicate under pressure, and make decisions. We’re not looking for perfection; we’re looking for clarity, ownership, and professionalism.

Reapplying?

If you’ve applied previously and were not selected, we encourage you to reapply. We release updated versions of this application each quarter to reflect evolving needs and give returning candidates another opportunity to be considered.

Privacy Notice

By applying, you acknowledge and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice.

$20—$28 USD

raw.description:
The Lock Desk Team Leader plays a critical role in overseeing daily lock desk operations, ensuring pricing accuracy, compliance with investor guidelines, and timely execution of rate lock requests. This position manages a team of Lock Desk Associates, provides training and support, resolves escalated issues, and collaborates with internal departments including Secondary Marketing, Underwriting, and Sales. The ideal candidate is highly organized, technically proficient, and experienced in mortgage pricing and lock procedures, with proven leadership abilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise the daily operations of the lock desk team, ensuring timely and accurate execution of rate lock requests.
  • Review and resolve escalated pricing or lock issues, including lock extensions, relocks, and pricing exceptions.
  • Ensure compliance with investor guidelines, company policies, and federal regulations related to rate locking.
  • Train, mentor, and support Lock Desk Associates to ensure team accuracy, consistency, and development.
  • Monitor team productivity and service level agreements (SLAs); generate and analyze performance reports.
  • Collaborate with Secondary Marketing, Sales, Processing, and Underwriting teams to resolve lock-related inquiries.
  • Maintain and update pricing templates and guidelines in Optimal Blue and/or other pricing engines.
  • Assist in testing and implementing system updates or guideline changes that impact pricing and locking procedures.
  • Support audits and quality control reviews by ensuring proper documentation and lock desk procedures are followed.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and contribute to policy and workflow enhancements.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in mortgage pricing, lock desk operations, or secondary marketing.
  • At least 1 year of leadership, supervisory, or training experience within a mortgage-related role preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of mortgage loan products including Conventional, FHA, VA, and Non-Agency.
  • Proficiency in Encompass, Optimal Blue, and investor portals (e.g., Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, or private investors).
  • Excellent analytical skills with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain complex pricing scenarios clearly.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while managing a team.
  • Understanding of interest rate trends, mortgage-backed securities, and loan pricing strategies is a plus.
  • Experience managing pricing exceptions or working closely with Secondary Marketing teams.
  • Familiarity with hedging strategies and pipeline management tools.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Knowledge of mortgage compliance requirements including TRID and lock disclosure timing.

Benefits

  • Above market salary
  • HMO on Day 1 for principal and two dependents
  • Government-mandated benefits
  • Performance-based Incentives
  • Quarterly Company Events
  • 1,000 PHP De Minimis
  • Equipment and software provided
